The violation described in Article 26: loading goods onto a motor vehicle, including a trailer or semi-trailer, so that its load exceeds the permitted carrying capacity recorded in the vehicle’s inspection certificate by more than 100%.
A road-traffic violation involving a vehicle with a valid circulation permit whose total weight or axle load, including any cargo, exceeds the limit specified in that permit.
A violation involving driving a commercial transport vehicle or an internal transport vehicle beyond the time limit prescribed by Article 64, Clause 1 of the Law on Road Traffic Order and Safety.

id: exceeding the permitted cargo loading height
ten: EXCEEDING THE PERMITTED CARGO LOADING HEIGHT
mo_ta: A road traffic violation in which a driver carries goods above the permitted loading height on a truck, including one towing a trailer or semi-trailer.
A violation involving a commercial transport vehicle being driven beyond the time limit set by Article 64, Clause 1 of the Law on Road Traffic Order and Safety.

id: exceeding the permitted number of learner drivers
ten: EXCEEDING THE PERMITTED NUMBER OF LEARNER DRIVERS
mo_ta: A violation in which a driver training institution assigns more learner drivers to practice in training vehicles than regulations permit.

A traffic violation in which a trailer or semi-trailer’s total weight exceeds the towing weight permitted in the towing vehicle’s technical safety and environmental protection inspection certificate by more than 50% and up to 100%. The stated fine is 5,000,000 to 7,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

id: exceeding the speed limit by 10–20 km/h
ten: EXCEEDING THE SPEED LIMIT BY 10–20 KM/H
mo_ta: A road traffic violation involving a vehicle being driven 10 to 20 km/h above the prescribed speed limit.

id: exceeding the speed limit by more than 20 km/h
ten: EXCEEDING THE SPEED LIMIT BY MORE THAN 20 KM/H
mo_ta: **EXCEEDING THE SPEED LIMIT BY MORE THAN 20 KM/H** is a road traffic violation involving a driver who travels more than 20 km/h above the prescribed speed limit. The stated penalty depends on the vehicle category: for a motorcycle, motorbike, or similar vehicle, the fine is **VND 6,000,000–8,000,000** under Article 7 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. The other description gives a fine of **VND 3,000,000–5,000,000** under Clause 6 of Article 8 of the decree. These ranges are presented as applying to different vehicle categories rather than as a single universal penalty.

id: exceeding vehicle or road dimension limits
ten: EXCEEDING VEHICLE OR ROAD DIMENSION LIMITS
mo_ta: A violation involving exceeding the permitted size limits for a vehicle or road.

id: exceeding vehicle or road load limits
ten: EXCEEDING VEHICLE OR ROAD LOAD LIMITS
mo_ta: **EXCEEDING VEHICLE OR ROAD LOAD LIMITS** refers to a violation of applicable regulations or limits on a vehicle’s load capacity or the load permitted on a road.

id: exceeding vehicle or road load or dimension limits
ten: EXCEEDING VEHICLE OR ROAD LOAD OR DIMENSION LIMITS
mo_ta: A violation of regulations governing vehicle load limits or the permitted dimensions of a vehicle or road.
The clause 3 conduct excluded from the penalty described in clause 1 for failing to obey traffic signals, signs, or road markings; the text does not specify what that conduct is

Operating a bicycle, motorized bicycle, or other rudimentary vehicle on a road with a blood alcohol concentration exceeding 80 milligrams per 100 milliliters of blood; the cited provision specifies a fine of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng.

Operating a bicycle, motorized bicycle, or other rudimentary vehicle on a road with a breath alcohol concentration exceeding 0.4 milligrams per liter of breath; the cited provision specifies a fine of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng.

A road traffic violation involving towing a trailer or semi-trailer whose total mass exceeds the vehicle’s permitted towing mass stated in its technical safety and environmental protection inspection certificate by more than 30% and up to 50%. The stated fine is 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

A traffic violation described in Clause 6 of Article 21 of Decree 168/2024/ND-CP: operating a vehicle while towing a trailer or semitrailer whose total mass exceeds the vehicle’s permitted towing mass recorded in its technical safety and environmental protection inspection certificate by more than 50% and up to 100%. The stated fine is 5,000,000 to 7,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.
A traffic violation involving towing a trailer or semi-trailer whose total weight exceeds the vehicle’s permitted towing weight by more than 30% and up to 50%.

id: exchange of a vehicle with an auction-winning plate
ten: EXCHANGE OF A VEHICLE WITH AN AUCTION-WINNING PLATE
mo_ta: The exchange of a vehicle associated with a license plate won at auction; in this case, only the vehicle registration certificate is revoked.
The exchange encouraged by Article 62 of non-expiring driving licenses issued before July 1, 2012, for driving licenses issued under the law.
A permitted action under Clause 1 of Article 38, allowing the auction winner to exchange the vehicle associated with the winning license plate.

id: exchange of vehicle registration certificates and license plates
ten: EXCHANGE OF VEHICLE REGISTRATION CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE PLATES
mo_ta: A procedure described in clause 3 of Article 39: registration certificates and license plates for motor vehicles and special-use motorcycles are exchanged when they are faded or damaged.

id: exchange or reissuance of driving licenses
ten: EXCHANGE OR REISSUANCE OF DRIVING LICENSES
mo_ta: The exchange or reissuance of a driving license under Law No. 36/2024/QH15, which determines whether the transitional continued-use rule applies.
The process of carrying out an administrative penalty decision; the text refers to cases where its execution deadline has passed.
The exemption from a vehicle’s first inspection, the procedures for which the Minister of Transport is to prescribe under Clause 5 of Article 42.
The event in which all points on a driving license are deducted, triggering a prohibition on driving under that license and eligibility to take the specified examination after at least six months.
Exhibitions are among the activities that foreign-registered vehicles may enter Vietnam temporarily to attend.

**EXIT FROM VIETNAM** refers to the departure of foreign nationals and foreign motor vehicles from Vietnam. Required customs procedures must be completed as part of the exit process. If an unforeseen incident prevents departure, a foreign national may be permitted to remain in Vietnam for up to 10 additional days, subject to the prescribed procedures.
Procedures that foreigners must complete under the laws governing departure from Vietnam.
The act of leaving a vehicle, which the provision addresses alongside opening the vehicle door and requires the person to undertake only after checking that it is safe.
A circumstance stated in Article 22(3) in which a permit to use signal devices on a priority vehicle has passed its period of validity.
The event of the statutory time limit for enforcing an administrative-violation sanction decision expiring.

id: expiration of provisions in circular no. 65/2024/tt-bca
ten: EXPIRATION OF PROVISIONS IN CIRCULAR NO. 65/2024/TT-BCA
mo_ta: The end of effectiveness of the provisions at Article 6, point b, clause 2; clause 4; and point b, clause 5 of Circular No. 65/2024/TT-BCA, upon the entry into force of Circular No. 105/2026/TT-BCA.
The event of the period for which a driver's license is temporarily retained expiring.
The end of the period during which collected technical results remain usable; if no sanctioning decision is issued by the deadline, those results lose their validity.

id: expiration of vehicle registration certificate and license plate
ten: EXPIRATION OF VEHICLE REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE AND LICENSE PLATE
mo_ta: The expiration of the validity period of a vehicle registration certificate or motor vehicle license plate, which is listed as a circumstance requiring replacement under Article 39 of Law 36/2024/QH15
The scheduled cessation of Article 2 of Decree No. 184/2025/ND-CP, effective 1 March 2027, unless the specified extension procedure applies.
An explosion that causes unsafe conditions for road traffic.
A designated economic zone where a police station may be situated under the text.
Police stations serving export processing zones whose chiefs are authorized, within assigned duties, to impose administrative penalties for specified road traffic violations.
A designated industrial or commercial area where a police post may operate.
A police post in an export processing zone whose chief is granted authority to impose specified administrative sanctions under the decree.
The head of a police post in an export-processing zone, authorized under Article 41 to impose administrative sanctions for specified road traffic violations within the assigned scope of duties.

The EXPORT-PROCESSING-ZONE POLICE STATION is a police station located in an export-processing zone. Its chief or head is authorized, within assigned functions and duties, to impose administrative penalties for specified road-traffic violations affecting traffic order and safety. The chief is identified as having these powers under Article 41 and Article 43, Clause 3.

The EXPORT-PROCESSING-ZONE POLICE STATION CHIEF is the official who heads a police station in an export processing zone. Under Article 43 of the decree, the chief is authorized to impose penalties and apply specified remedial measures.

An **EXPRESSWAY** is a high-speed road with traffic lanes, entry and exit points, shoulders, and emergency stopping lanes. The cited rules regulate vehicle speeds, lane use and changes, stopping and parking, and prohibit driving against traffic, reversing, and U-turns, subject to any stated exceptions. They also prohibit driving or leading animals and operating animal-drawn vehicles on the expressway. Vehicles may enter only when permitted—for example, vehicles used for its management or maintenance—and pedestrians are prohibited except when performing such work. The rules also restrict stopping or parking outside designated areas and prohibit changing lanes without advance signaling; lane changes must be made one adjacent lane at a time.

EXPRESSWAY MANAGEMENT AND MAINTENANCE refers to activities carried out to manage or maintain an expressway. Vehicles engaged in these activities are excepted from the prohibition on driving onto the expressway and are exempt from the related penalty.
People serving in the management or maintenance of an expressway, who are excepted from the stated prohibition on entering it.
The shoulder of an expressway; driving on it is identified as a traffic violation.
A lane used by moving traffic on an expressway, where a stopped vehicle must be appropriately signaled and warned about.

Traffic violations described in Clause 5, Article 6 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, including failing to follow rules when entering or exiting an expressway, driving in an emergency stopping lane or on the expressway shoulder, and failing to maintain a safe distance from the vehicle ahead. These violations are subject to a fine of 4,000,000 to 6,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

**Expressways** are roads designated as expressways under the relevant Vietnamese traffic regulations. Article 9 addresses permitted operating speeds on these roads, including their entry and exit ramps, and requires signs displaying maximum and minimum speeds. The permitted speeds are determined under an approved traffic organization plan; a special minimum-speed rule applies to expressways designed for 60 km/h.

The law prohibits certain vehicles and pedestrians from entering or using expressways, except people, vehicles, and equipment serving their management or maintenance. Driving onto an expressway in violation of the rules may incur a fine of 800,000 to 1,200,000 Vietnamese đồng; vehicles used to manage or maintain expressways are excepted. Drivers and operators of specialized motorcycles on expressways must follow the applicable road-traffic rules, and the regulation also prohibits specified commercial-transport conduct on these roads.

Expressways may be managed, operated, and maintained by enterprises assigned by the Vietnamese State. The competent authority determines where speed-limit signs are placed within its area of responsibility. For expressways covered by the regulation and managed by assigned enterprises, the Vietnam Road Administration may decide where operational-speed signs are placed.
A possible extension of the period for applying the relevant article, proposed by the Ministry of Public Security and subject to a decision by the National Assembly.

id: extension of the penalty decision deadline
ten: EXTENSION OF THE PENALTY DECISION DEADLINE
mo_ta: An extension that may be granted to the time limit for issuing a penalty decision when further verification of the person subject to the penalty is required.
The issuance by an enterprise of a factory quality inspection slip, with its number and issue date among the information described for the database.
The activity of checking the factory-release quality of motor vehicles, special-use motorcycles, or motor vehicle parts.

id: failing to maintain a safe distance on an expressway
ten: FAILING TO MAINTAIN A SAFE DISTANCE ON AN EXPRESSWAY
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation consisting of failing to keep the required safe distance from the vehicle ahead while driving on an expressway.

id: failing to provide access to the transport-document software
ten: FAILING TO PROVIDE ACCESS TO THE TRANSPORT-DOCUMENT SOFTWARE
mo_ta: A violation in which a driver has a device capable of accessing the software displaying the required cargo transport document but fails to provide access to competent authorities when requested.

id: failure of test vehicles to meet required conditions
ten: FAILURE OF TEST VEHICLES TO MEET REQUIRED CONDITIONS
mo_ta: A specified violation in which more than 50% of the licensed driving-test vehicles at a driving test center in a province do not meet the conditions required for testing.

id: failure of the public audio announcement system
ten: FAILURE OF THE PUBLIC AUDIO ANNOUNCEMENT SYSTEM
mo_ta: A violation in which a driving test center either lacks the required system for publicly announcing candidates’ errors during a practical driving test or has a system that does not operate as required.

id: failure to assign a required escort for dangerous-goods transport
ten: FAILURE TO ASSIGN A REQUIRED ESCORT FOR DANGEROUS-GOODS TRANSPORT
mo_ta: A violation consisting of not assigning an escort to a vehicle transporting dangerous goods in cases where an escort is required

id: failure to assist an injured person
ten: FAILURE TO ASSIST AN INJURED PERSON
mo_ta: **FAILURE TO ASSIST AN INJURED PERSON** refers to a driver’s deliberate failure to help someone injured in a road traffic accident when the driver is able to provide assistance. The failure occurs after conduct directly related to the accident and is identified as a violation punishable by a fine.
A traffic violation in which a driver involved in a road traffic accident does not assist injured people.

id: failure to carry a container for animal waste
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A CONTAINER FOR ANIMAL WASTE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation under Article 11 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP: failing to have a suitable container for animal waste. The text states that this violation is subject to a fine of 150,000 to 250,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to carry a driving license
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A DRIVING LICENSE
mo_ta: A traffic violation described in Article 18, Clause 2 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP: a driver operating a motorcycle or similar vehicle for commercial transport does not carry a driving license, except for the specified exceptions in that provision.

id: failure to carry a passenger list
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A PASSENGER LIST
mo_ta: A violation in which a driver operating passenger transport under a written contract does not have or carry the required passenger list.

id: failure to carry a required inspection certificate
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A REQUIRED INSPECTION CERTIFICATE
mo_ta: An administrative traffic violation described in Article 18(3) of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP: a driver operating a specified vehicle used for transport business does not carry the technical safety and environmental protection inspection certificate when that vehicle is required to undergo inspection.

id: failure to carry a required vehicle inspection certificate
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A REQUIRED VEHICLE INSPECTION CERTIFICATE
mo_ta: A violation involving a driver of a car, four-wheeled motor vehicle for passenger or cargo transport, trailer, semi-trailer, or similar vehicle used for commercial transport failing to carry the required technical-safety and environmental-protection inspection certificate.

id: failure to carry a temporary import-re-export declaration
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A TEMPORARY IMPORT-RE-EXPORT DECLARATION
mo_ta: A violation in which a driver lacks the prescribed temporary import and re-export declaration for a road transport vehicle. Article 38, Clause 1, specifies a fine of 500,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese dong for this violation.

id: failure to carry a temporary import-re-export road transport declaration
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A TEMPORARY IMPORT-RE-EXPORT ROAD TRANSPORT DECLARATION
mo_ta: A violation consisting of not having the required declaration for a road transport vehicle temporarily imported and re-exported.

id: failure to carry a transport contract
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A TRANSPORT CONTRACT
mo_ta: A violation in which a driver operating passenger transport under a contract does not have or carry the required transport contract.

id: failure to carry a valid compulsory civil liability insurance certificate
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A VALID COMPULSORY CIVIL LIABILITY INSURANCE CERTIFICATE
mo_ta: A traffic violation described in Article 18: operating a car, motorized four-wheel passenger vehicle, motorized four-wheel cargo vehicle, or similar vehicle used for transport business without carrying a valid compulsory civil liability insurance certificate.

id: failure to carry a vehicle registration certificate
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY A VEHICLE REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE
mo_ta: A violation described in Article 18: operating a covered vehicle used for transport business without carrying its vehicle registration certificate, or the specified certified copy and bank receipt when the original is held by a credit institution or foreign bank branch. The stated fine is 300,000 to 400,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to carry valid compulsory civil liability insurance
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY VALID COMPULSORY CIVIL LIABILITY INSURANCE
mo_ta: A violation in which a driver operating a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle for transport business does not carry a valid certificate of the vehicle owner's compulsory civil liability insurance.

id: failure to carry vehicle registration documents
ten: FAILURE TO CARRY VEHICLE REGISTRATION DOCUMENTS
mo_ta: The specified traffic violation involving a transport-business operator of a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle not carrying the vehicle registration certificate or the prescribed substitute documents.
The violator's failure to come and claim the driver's license without a legitimate reason.

id: failure to clean animal waste from a road or sidewalk
ten: FAILURE TO CLEAN ANIMAL WASTE FROM A ROAD OR SIDEWALK
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation under Article 11 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP: failing to clean animal waste deposited on a road or sidewalk. The text states that this violation is subject to a fine of 150,000 to 250,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to clean vehicle or remove hazard symbol
ten: FAILURE TO CLEAN VEHICLE OR REMOVE HAZARD SYMBOL
mo_ta: The act of failing to clean a vehicle or remove its hazardous-goods warning symbol after hazardous-goods transportation has ended.

id: failure to close passenger vehicle doors while moving
ten: FAILURE TO CLOSE PASSENGER VEHICLE DOORS WHILE MOVING
mo_ta: A traffic-rule violation in which the driver of a passenger-carrying car or a similar vehicle fails to close its doors while the vehicle is moving. Under Article 20, Clause 3 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, it is subject to a fine of 600,000 to 800,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to complete vehicle document revocation procedures
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLETE VEHICLE DOCUMENT REVOCATION PROCEDURES
mo_ta: A road-traffic regulatory violation involving a vehicle owner’s failure to complete required procedures to revoke the vehicle registration certificate, license plate, and vehicle inspection certificate.

id: failure to complete vehicle registration and license plate revocation procedures
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLETE VEHICLE REGISTRATION AND LICENSE PLATE REVOCATION PROCEDURES
mo_ta: “FAILURE TO COMPLETE VEHICLE REGISTRATION AND LICENSE PLATE REVOCATION PROCEDURES” is a road-traffic regulatory violation involving failure to carry out the legally required procedures to revoke a vehicle’s registration certificate and license plate.

id: failure to complete vehicle registration change procedures
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLETE VEHICLE REGISTRATION CHANGE PROCEDURES
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation involving failure to complete the required procedures for changing a vehicle registration certificate or license plate. The cited provision sets fines for individual and organizational owners of specified vehicles.)

id: failure to complete vehicle registration changes
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLETE VEHICLE REGISTRATION CHANGES
mo_ta: A road traffic violation described in the decree: failing to complete the required procedure to change a vehicle registration certificate or license plate.

id: failure to complete vehicle registration procedures after a change of owner
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLETE VEHICLE REGISTRATION PROCEDURES AFTER A CHANGE OF OWNER
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation described as failing to complete the required procedures for issuing a vehicle registration certificate and license plate when ownership changes; the cited provision prescribes monetary fines for the vehicle owner.

id: failure to comply with a circulation permit
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH A CIRCULATION PERMIT
mo_ta: **FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH A CIRCULATION PERMIT** is a violation involving failure to follow the requirements stated in a vehicle circulation permit while transporting oversized or overweight goods. It is subject to a fine of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 Vietnamese dong, subject to applicable exceptions.

id: failure to comply with inspection and control requests
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH INSPECTION AND CONTROL REQUESTS
mo_ta: “FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH INSPECTION AND CONTROL REQUESTS” refers to conduct addressed by Article 73 in which road traffic participants fail to comply with requests made during an inspection or control.

id: failure to comply with license-plate and vehicle-marking requirements
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH LICENSE-PLATE AND VEHICLE-MARKING REQUIREMENTS
mo_ta: The violation of failing to follow requirements for license plates, lettering or numbers on plates, or information displayed on vehicle bodies or doors, including trailers and semi-trailers.

id: failure to comply with official traffic inspection or control
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH OFFICIAL TRAFFIC INSPECTION OR CONTROL
mo_ta: A traffic-related violation in which an individual or organization does not comply with an official’s inspection or control request concerning road traffic order and safety. Article 12 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP prescribes fines for this conduct, subject to the stated exceptions.

id: failure to comply with posted transport information
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH POSTED TRANSPORT INFORMATION
mo_ta: A road-transport violation involving failure to follow posted information about a route, schedule, or transport itinerary.

id: failure to comply with posted vehicle information
ten: FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH POSTED VEHICLE INFORMATION
mo_ta: A violation consisting of failing to comply with the information displayed on a vehicle as required by regulations.

id: failure to declare a vehicle modification
ten: FAILURE TO DECLARE A VEHICLE MODIFICATION
mo_ta: A violation consisting of failing to complete the required procedure with the vehicle registration authority before modifying a vehicle for which advance declaration is required.

id: failure to display establishment name and phone number
ten: FAILURE TO DISPLAY ESTABLISHMENT NAME AND PHONE NUMBER
mo_ta: A violation in which a driving training establishment fails to display its name and phone number on the outside of both vehicle doors or both sides of the vehicle body as required.

id: failure to display required schoolchild-transport sign
ten: FAILURE TO DISPLAY REQUIRED SCHOOLCHILD-TRANSPORT SIGN
mo_ta: A violation by the driver of a commercial passenger vehicle transporting preschool children or students, or providing combined transport and pickup services for them, when the vehicle lacks the prescribed sign identifying it as a vehicle carrying preschool children or students. Under Article 27, clause 3 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the violation is subject to a fine of 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to display the required practice-vehicle sign
ten: FAILURE TO DISPLAY THE REQUIRED PRACTICE-VEHICLE SIGN
mo_ta: A violation in which a driving training establishment fails to attach the required “Tập lái” sign to a practice vehicle.

id: failure to display warning signs on a towing vehicle and towed vehicle
ten: FAILURE TO DISPLAY WARNING SIGNS ON A TOWING VEHICLE AND TOWED VEHICLE
mo_ta: A road traffic violation consisting of failing to display a warning sign at the front of a towing vehicle and at the rear of the vehicle being towed.

id: failure to ensure safety when a vehicle breaks down at a level crossing
ten: FAILURE TO ENSURE SAFETY WHEN A VEHICLE BREAKS DOWN AT A LEVEL CROSSING
mo_ta: A road traffic violation in which a driver fails to take required safety measures when a car breaks down at a level crossing between a road and a railway.

id: failure to follow an approved transport route or itinerary
ten: FAILURE TO FOLLOW AN APPROVED TRANSPORT ROUTE OR ITINERARY
mo_ta: A violation involving a passenger-carrying automobile or similar vehicle operating outside its legally permitted route, schedule, or transport itinerary. Article 20, clause 3 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP provides for a fine of 600,000 to 800,000 VND for this violation.

id: failure to follow expressway entry or exit rules
ten: FAILURE TO FOLLOW EXPRESSWAY ENTRY OR EXIT RULES
mo_ta: A traffic violation involving failure to comply with regulations when entering or exiting an expressway.

id: failure to follow stopping and parking rules at a railway level crossing
ten: FAILURE TO FOLLOW STOPPING AND PARKING RULES AT A RAILWAY LEVEL CROSSING
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation consisting of failing to comply with stopping or parking rules where a road crosses a railway at the same level
An event in which an operator involved in an accident fails to stop immediately, preserve the scene, assist injured people, remain at the scene, or promptly report the accident.

id: failure to give a warning when stopped in a road tunnel
ten: FAILURE TO GIVE A WARNING WHEN STOPPED IN A ROAD TUNNEL
mo_ta: A violation involving failure to activate hazard lights or place a warning sign or warning light behind a vehicle when an emergency or other unavoidable circumstance requires it to stop in a road tunnel.

id: failure to guide children to designated seats
ten: FAILURE TO GUIDE CHILDREN TO DESIGNATED SEATS
mo_ta: A traffic violation in which a driver transporting preschool children or students does not guide them to sit in the designated positions in the vehicle. The text states that this violation is punishable by a fine of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

id: failure to guide passengers to sit, stand, or lie in permitted positions
ten: FAILURE TO GUIDE PASSENGERS TO SIT, STAND, OR LIE IN PERMITTED POSITIONS
mo_ta: A traffic-safety violation involving a vehicle operator who does not instruct passengers to sit, stand, or lie in the positions prescribed inside the vehicle. The stated fine is 100,000 to 200,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to have required monitoring equipment
ten: FAILURE TO HAVE REQUIRED MONITORING EQUIPMENT
mo_ta: A violation in which a driving training facility or driving test center lacks equipment required to monitor learners’ theoretical study time and practical driving time and distance.

id: failure to help an injured person
ten: FAILURE TO HELP AN INJURED PERSON
mo_ta: Deliberately failing to assist a person injured in a road traffic accident when able to do so, prohibited by Article 9 of Law 36/2024/QH15.

id: failure to install a driver-image recording device
ten: FAILURE TO INSTALL A DRIVER-IMAGE RECORDING DEVICE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation described in the decree: putting a covered vehicle into traffic without the required device for recording images of the driver.

id: failure to install an ambulance driver image-recording device
ten: FAILURE TO INSTALL AN AMBULANCE DRIVER IMAGE-RECORDING DEVICE
mo_ta: A traffic violation in which an ambulance is operated without a device installed to record the driver's image.

id: failure to install driver-image recording equipment
ten: FAILURE TO INSTALL DRIVER-IMAGE RECORDING EQUIPMENT
mo_ta: A violation consisting of operating a passenger car with at least eight passenger seats, excluding the driver’s seat, for passenger transport without installing equipment to record images of the driver.

id: failure to issue driver identification cards
ten: FAILURE TO ISSUE DRIVER IDENTIFICATION CARDS
mo_ta: A violation described in Article 26: failing to issue drivers the identification cards required by regulations. The stated fine is 3,000,000–4,000,000 Vietnamese dong for individuals and 6,000,000–8,000,000 Vietnamese dong for transport businesses or transport-support-service organizations.

id: failure to issue required transport orders or documents
ten: FAILURE TO ISSUE REQUIRED TRANSPORT ORDERS OR DOCUMENTS
mo_ta: A violation in which a required transport order or transport document is not issued to a driver, or is issued contrary to regulations.

id: failure to keep right or use the prescribed part of the road
ten: FAILURE TO KEEP RIGHT OR USE THE PRESCRIBED PART OF THE ROAD
mo_ta: A road traffic violation described in Article 9: traveling other than on the right side in the direction of travel or outside the prescribed part of the road.

id: failure to keep to the correct road or lane or safe distance
ten: FAILURE TO KEEP TO THE CORRECT ROAD OR LANE OR SAFE DISTANCE
mo_ta: Operating a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle without using the correct part of the road or lane, or without maintaining the prescribed safe distance between vehicles, thereby causing a traffic accident. The provision sets a fine of 10,000,000 to 14,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for this violation.

id: failure to keep to the right side of the road
ten: FAILURE TO KEEP TO THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE ROAD
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation described in Article 8, Clause 6: driving without keeping to the right side in the direction of travel.

id: failure to maintain a safe distance causing a traffic accident
ten: FAILURE TO MAINTAIN A SAFE DISTANCE CAUSING A TRAFFIC ACCIDENT
mo_ta: Failing to maintain the prescribed safe distance between vehicles and causing a traffic accident.

id: failure to maintain a safe following distance
ten: FAILURE TO MAINTAIN A SAFE FOLLOWING DISTANCE
mo_ta: **FAILURE TO MAINTAIN A SAFE FOLLOWING DISTANCE** is a road-traffic violation in which a driver fails to keep the required safe distance from the vehicle immediately ahead. It includes driving too closely on an expressway, failing to observe a minimum-distance sign, or failing to maintain a safe gap in a way that causes a collision. Under Clause 4, the violation is punishable by a fine of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

“FAILURE TO MAINTAIN REQUIRED CONDITIONS” refers to a violation in which a driving test center fails to maintain the conditions required by the national technical regulation, subject to the exceptions set out in Article 39. It also covers a vehicle inspection establishment’s failure to maintain the prescribed conditions and requirements for its business or operation. For the vehicle-inspection-establishment violation, the stated fine is 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

A road transport-related violation consisting of failing to provide, update, transmit, store, or manage information and data collected by an in-vehicle device that records images of the driver. The text specifies fines of VND 5,000,000–6,000,000 for an individual and VND 10,000,000–12,000,000 for an organization carrying out transport or transport-support services.

id: failure to meet driving test vehicle conditions
ten: FAILURE TO MEET DRIVING TEST VEHICLE CONDITIONS
mo_ta: A violation in which more than half of a driving test center’s licensed on-road test vehicles fail to meet the prescribed conditions for conducting tests.

id: failure to meet urban vehicle sanitation requirements
ten: FAILURE TO MEET URBAN VEHICLE SANITATION REQUIREMENTS
mo_ta: The act of operating a vehicle in an urban area without meeting the required sanitation standards for circulation.

id: failure to number passenger seats or berths
ten: FAILURE TO NUMBER PASSENGER SEATS OR BERTHS
mo_ta: A road transport violation involving failure to number seats or berths on a passenger-carrying motor vehicle as required by regulations

id: failure to obey a stop signal or order
ten: FAILURE TO OBEY A STOP SIGNAL OR ORDER
mo_ta: A road vehicle operator's failure to comply with a signal or order to stop the vehicle.

id: failure to obey a traffic signal
ten: FAILURE TO OBEY A TRAFFIC SIGNAL
mo_ta: A road traffic violation in which a driver fails to obey a traffic signal. Under Article 7, the stated fine for this violation is between 4,000,000 and 6,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to obey traffic controller instructions
ten: FAILURE TO OBEY TRAFFIC CONTROLLER INSTRUCTIONS
mo_ta: A road traffic violation in which a driver fails to comply with the commands or instructions of a traffic controller or traffic-control officer. Under Article 6, Clause 9 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the violation is punishable by a fine of 18,000,000 to 20,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for the specified types of vehicles.

**FAILURE TO OBEY TRAFFIC DIRECTIONS** is a road-traffic violation involving failure to comply with commands, instructions, or directions issued by a traffic controller or traffic-control officer. It may apply to drivers and, in some cases, pedestrians. One description specifies a fine of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese dong for the violation.

A road traffic violation in which a vehicle driver does not obey traffic signal lights. Under Clause 2 of Article 9 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, it is punishable by a fine of 150,000 to 250,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to obey traffic signals, signs, or road markings
ten: FAILURE TO OBEY TRAFFIC SIGNALS, SIGNS, OR ROAD MARKINGS
mo_ta: A road traffic violation consisting of failing to obey the instructions or directions of traffic lights, signs, or road markings; the stated provision applies to people handling or guiding animals and drivers of animal-drawn vehicles

id: failure to obey traffic signs and road markings
ten: FAILURE TO OBEY TRAFFIC SIGNS AND ROAD MARKINGS
mo_ta: “FAILURE TO OBEY TRAFFIC SIGNS AND ROAD MARKINGS” is a road-traffic violation involving a driver’s failure to comply with instructions indicated by traffic signs or road markings. Under Clause 1 of Article 7, applicable drivers are subject to a fine of 200,000 to 400,000 Vietnamese dong, subject to the stated exceptions.

id: failure to obey traffic signs or road markings
ten: FAILURE TO OBEY TRAFFIC SIGNS OR ROAD MARKINGS
mo_ta: **FAILURE TO OBEY TRAFFIC SIGNS OR ROAD MARKINGS** is a road traffic violation in which a driver fails to follow the instructions given by traffic signs or road markings. The descriptions cite the violation under Article 6 and, separately, Article 9, Clause 1, with specified exceptions. One description states that the applicable fine is 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese dong; the other does not specify a penalty.

id: failure to observe or slow down or stop safely
ten: FAILURE TO OBSERVE OR SLOW DOWN OR STOP SAFELY
mo_ta: Operating a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle without observing, reducing speed, or stopping as required to ensure safety, thereby causing a traffic accident. The provision sets a fine of 10,000,000 to 14,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for this violation.

id: failure to observe required breaks between continuous driving periods
ten: FAILURE TO OBSERVE REQUIRED BREAKS BETWEEN CONTINUOUS DRIVING PERIODS
mo_ta: A violation involving failure to comply with the required rest period between two continuous driving periods.

id: failure to observe required rest periods
ten: FAILURE TO OBSERVE REQUIRED REST PERIODS
mo_ta: A violation involving a driver failing to take the required rest period between two consecutive driving sessions.

id: failure to observe the required rest period
ten: FAILURE TO OBSERVE THE REQUIRED REST PERIOD
mo_ta: A violation in which a driver does not comply with the required rest period between two continuous driving periods.

id: failure to organize periodic health examinations for drivers
ten: FAILURE TO ORGANIZE PERIODIC HEALTH EXAMINATIONS FOR DRIVERS
mo_ta: A road transport regulatory violation involving either not arranging periodic health examinations for drivers or arranging examinations that omit required content. The text specifies fines of 10,000,000–12,000,000 VND for individuals and 20,000,000–24,000,000 VND for transport businesses or transport-support service organizations.
An unsuccessful examination result. A participant who fails may register for a retake after seven working days; a participant who fails the theoretical test cannot proceed to the simulated test.

id: failure to pay the full winning bid
ten: FAILURE TO PAY THE FULL WINNING BID
mo_ta: A winner’s failure to pay the full auction amount within 30 days of the result notification, including paying nothing or paying less than the full amount.
A violation in which an individual does not properly carry out assigned responsibilities in the certification or inspection of motor vehicles, specialized motor vehicles, or motor vehicle parts.

**FAILURE TO PRESENT REQUIRED DOCUMENTS** refers to a vehicle operator’s inability or failure to produce one or more required documents during an inspection, including a driver’s license or vehicle registration certificate. The required documents may be presented in paper form or through information integrated into an electronic identification account. The violation also applies when the operator does not provide the documents or their electronic information by the deadline for resolving the violation.

id: failure to preserve the accident scene
ten: FAILURE TO PRESERVE THE ACCIDENT SCENE
mo_ta: “FAILURE TO PRESERVE THE ACCIDENT SCENE” is a traffic violation in which a driver involved in a road traffic accident fails to keep the scene unchanged, particularly when the driver’s conduct is directly related to the accident.

FAILURE TO PROVE VEHICLE ORIGIN refers to the inability to establish a vehicle’s origin or lawful ownership using the required documents, certificates of origin, or other proof. When this failure occurs alongside the specified registration-document violations, the vehicle may be confiscated.

id: failure to provide a qualified driving practice yard
ten: FAILURE TO PROVIDE A QUALIFIED DRIVING PRACTICE YARD
mo_ta: A violation in which a driver training institution lacks a sufficient driving practice yard or its yard does not satisfy regulatory requirements.

id: failure to provide adequate classroom facilities and teaching equipment
ten: FAILURE TO PROVIDE ADEQUATE CLASSROOM FACILITIES AND TEACHING EQUIPMENT
mo_ta: A violation consisting of a driving training establishment lacking the required classroom system or having classrooms without sufficient equipment and teaching models.

id: failure to provide functioning display screens
ten: FAILURE TO PROVIDE FUNCTIONING DISPLAY SCREENS
mo_ta: A violation in which a driving test center lacks enough screens to display required monitoring images and test results, or has enough screens but they do not operate as required during the examination. The stated fine is 10,000,000 to 20,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

id: failure to provide or manage journey-monitoring data
ten: FAILURE TO PROVIDE OR MANAGE JOURNEY-MONITORING DATA
mo_ta: A violation consisting of failing to provide, update, transmit, store, or manage information and data from a journey-monitoring device as required by regulations.

id: failure to provide passenger safety and emergency instructions
ten: FAILURE TO PROVIDE PASSENGER SAFETY AND EMERGENCY INSTRUCTIONS
mo_ta: A traffic violation committed when a driver operating a passenger-transport automobile fails to give passengers the required instructions on traffic safety and how to evacuate in an emergency. The text states that this violation is subject to a fine of 600,000 to 800,000 đồng.

id: failure to provide passenger safety and emergency-exit guidance
ten: FAILURE TO PROVIDE PASSENGER SAFETY AND EMERGENCY-EXIT GUIDANCE
mo_ta: A violation involving the use of a commercial passenger vehicle without providing passengers with the required guidance on traffic safety and how to evacuate in an emergency. Under Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the fine is 1,000,000–2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for an individual and 2,000,000–4,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for a transport business organization.

id: failure to provide the electronic contract and passenger list
ten: FAILURE TO PROVIDE THE ELECTRONIC CONTRACT AND PASSENGER LIST
mo_ta: A violation in which a contract-based passenger transport vehicle has access to its electronic contract and passenger list but does not provide them to the competent authorities when requested. The decree sets a fine of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for this violation.

id: failure to publicly disclose required information
ten: FAILURE TO PUBLICLY DISCLOSE REQUIRED INFORMATION
mo_ta: A violation consisting of failing to publicly disclose the recruitment rules, training management rules, and tuition fees as required

id: failure to publicly post testing and certification procedures
ten: FAILURE TO PUBLICLY POST TESTING AND CERTIFICATION PROCEDURES
mo_ta: The violation of not publicly displaying the required testing and certification processes and procedures.

id: failure to record or store driver-image data
ten: FAILURE TO RECORD OR STORE DRIVER-IMAGE DATA
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation involving a required driver-image recording device that is installed but fails to record or store data while the vehicle is participating in traffic.

id: failure to register a vehicle ownership change
ten: FAILURE TO REGISTER A VEHICLE OWNERSHIP CHANGE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation involving failure to complete the required procedures to obtain an updated vehicle registration certificate and license plate after a change of vehicle owner.

id: failure to report journey-monitoring device software updates or changes
ten: FAILURE TO REPORT JOURNEY-MONITORING DEVICE SOFTWARE UPDATES OR CHANGES
mo_ta: A violation in which a producer, assembler, or importer of car journey-monitoring devices fails to report software updates or changes as required by regulations.

id: failure to resolve a violation by the deadline
ten: FAILURE TO RESOLVE A VIOLATION BY THE DEADLINE
mo_ta: A vehicle owner or violator does not resolve the violation by the appointment deadline recorded in the administrative violation record or competent authority’s notice, or does not comply with the penalty decision by its deadline.
A violation in which a driving test center fails to retain required records, or retains incomplete records, for two or more driving-test sessions.

id: failure to retain required training records
ten: FAILURE TO RETAIN REQUIRED TRAINING RECORDS
mo_ta: A violation in which a driver training establishment does not retain required records, or retains incomplete records, for two or more training courses. The cited provision sets a fine of 10,000,000 to 20,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for this violation.

id: failure to secure a stopped vehicle
ten: FAILURE TO SECURE A STOPPED VEHICLE
mo_ta: A traffic violation involving leaving the driver’s position while stopped without using the parking brake or another safety measure.
A violation involving failure to comply with regulations for securing transported cargo.

id: failure to signal a stop in an emergency stopping area
ten: FAILURE TO SIGNAL A STOP IN AN EMERGENCY STOPPING AREA
mo_ta: A traffic violation involving failure to activate hazard lights when a technical problem or other unavoidable circumstance requires stopping in a highway emergency stopping lane or area.

id: failure to signal before changing lanes on an expressway
ten: FAILURE TO SIGNAL BEFORE CHANGING LANES ON AN EXPRESSWAY
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation involving changing lanes on an expressway without giving an advance signal.

id: failure to signal by hand when turning
ten: FAILURE TO SIGNAL BY HAND WHEN TURNING
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation identified in Article 11: failing to signal by hand when changing direction

id: failure to signal or place a warning sign during a forced stop
ten: FAILURE TO SIGNAL OR PLACE A WARNING SIGN DURING A FORCED STOP
mo_ta: A traffic violation involving a driver who, when a technical failure or other force majeure requires stopping partly in a traffic lane or where parking is prohibited, fails to use hazard lights or place the required “Caution: Parked Vehicle” warning sign. Article 6 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP provides a fine of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese dong for this conduct, subject to the stated exception for another violation under Article 7, Clause 7, Point c.

id: failure to signal or place a warning sign when forced to park
ten: FAILURE TO SIGNAL OR PLACE A WARNING SIGN WHEN FORCED TO PARK
mo_ta: A traffic violation consisting of failing to use hazard lights or place a “Caution: Parked Vehicle” sign when a technical failure or other force majeure requires parking partly in a traffic lane or in a prohibited parking area, except for the separately specified case.

id: failure to signal properly while overtaking
ten: FAILURE TO SIGNAL PROPERLY WHILE OVERTAKING
mo_ta: A traffic violation involving either failing to signal before overtaking or signaling an overtake but failing to maintain the signal throughout the maneuver. The stated fine is 200,000 to 400,000 Vietnamese dong.
A road traffic violation involving signaling to overtake but failing to use the signal for the entire overtaking maneuver.

id: failure to signal when entering or leaving a stopping or parking position
ten: FAILURE TO SIGNAL WHEN ENTERING OR LEAVING A STOPPING OR PARKING POSITION
mo_ta: A road traffic violation committed when a driver enters or leaves a vehicle stopping or parking position without signaling to other vehicle operators. The text states that this violation is punishable by a fine of 600,000 to 800,000 Vietnamese đồng under Clause 2, Article 8 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.

id: failure to slow down and yield to traffic from the left at a signed roundabout intersection
ten: FAILURE TO SLOW DOWN AND YIELD TO TRAFFIC FROM THE LEFT AT A SIGNED ROUNDABOUT INTERSECTION
mo_ta: A road traffic violation in which a driver fails to slow down and yield to a vehicle approaching from the left at an intersection with a roundabout-priority sign.

id: failure to slow down and yield to traffic from the right at an unsignalized roundabout intersection
ten: FAILURE TO SLOW DOWN AND YIELD TO TRAFFIC FROM THE RIGHT AT AN UNSIGNALIZED ROUNDABOUT INTERSECTION
mo_ta: A road traffic violation in which a driver fails to slow down and yield to a vehicle approaching from the right at an intersection without a roundabout-priority sign.

id: failure to slow down and yield to vehicles approaching from the left
ten: FAILURE TO SLOW DOWN AND YIELD TO VEHICLES APPROACHING FROM THE LEFT
mo_ta: A road traffic violation by a motorcycle or similar vehicle driver who fails to slow down and yield to a vehicle approaching from the left at an intersection with a roundabout-direction sign. Under Clause 6 of Article 7 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, this violation carries a fine of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

id: failure to slow down and yield to vehicles approaching from the right
ten: FAILURE TO SLOW DOWN AND YIELD TO VEHICLES APPROACHING FROM THE RIGHT
mo_ta: A road traffic violation by a motorcycle or similar vehicle driver who fails to slow down and yield to a vehicle approaching from the right at an intersection without a roundabout-direction sign. Under Clause 6 of Article 7 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, this violation carries a fine of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

id: failure to slow down or stop and yield
ten: FAILURE TO SLOW DOWN OR STOP AND YIELD
mo_ta: “FAILURE TO SLOW DOWN OR STOP AND YIELD” is a road-traffic violation committed when a bicycle, motorized-bicycle, or other rudimentary-vehicle driver enters a priority road from a non-priority road, or a main road from a branch or side road, without slowing down or stopping to yield. Under Article 9, Clause 1 of Decree 168/2024/ND-CP, the violation carries a fine of 100,000 to 200,000 Vietnamese dong.

id: failure to slow down or yield
ten: FAILURE TO SLOW DOWN OR YIELD
mo_ta: “FAILURE TO SLOW DOWN OR YIELD” is a road traffic violation that occurs when a driver enters a priority road from a non-priority road, or a main road from a side road, without slowing down or stopping and yielding as required.

**FAILURE TO STOP IMMEDIATELY** is a traffic violation in which a driver involved in a road traffic accident fails to stop the vehicle at once, when the driver’s conduct is directly related to the accident.

id: failure to stop or assist after an accident
ten: FAILURE TO STOP OR ASSIST AFTER AN ACCIDENT
mo_ta: A traffic violation in which a driver of a motorcycle or similar vehicle involved in a road traffic accident does not stop immediately, preserve the scene, or assist injured people.

id: failure to stop, preserve the scene, or assist an injured person
ten: FAILURE TO STOP, PRESERVE THE SCENE, OR ASSIST AN INJURED PERSON
mo_ta: A specified violation in which a driver involved in conduct directly related to a traffic accident fails to stop immediately, preserve the scene, or help an injured person, subject to an exception stated in the text.

id: failure to store required training records
ten: FAILURE TO STORE REQUIRED TRAINING RECORDS
mo_ta: A violation in which a driving training facility fails to retain, or incompletely retains, records for a training course.

id: failure to take safety measures at a railway level crossing
ten: FAILURE TO TAKE SAFETY MEASURES AT A RAILWAY LEVEL CROSSING
mo_ta: A road traffic violation in which a driver fails to take the required safety measures when a vehicle breaks down at a level crossing between a road and a railway.

A regulatory violation consisting of failing to update records for motor vehicles or specialized-use motorcycles as required. The cited provision sets a fine of 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 Vietnamese dong for this conduct.

id: failure to use a driver identification card
ten: FAILURE TO USE A DRIVER IDENTIFICATION CARD
mo_ta: **FAILURE TO USE A DRIVER IDENTIFICATION CARD** is a traffic violation in which a driver fails to use their driver identification card to log required information while operating a vehicle. It applies to drivers operating either a cargo-transport vehicle for cargo-transport business or a passenger car.

id: failure to use an appropriate child safety device
ten: FAILURE TO USE AN APPROPRIATE CHILD SAFETY DEVICE
mo_ta: The prohibited conduct of failing to use an appropriate child safety device as required by the regulations.

id: failure to use hazard lights in the emergency stopping lane
ten: FAILURE TO USE HAZARD LIGHTS IN THE EMERGENCY STOPPING LANE
mo_ta: The violation of failing to signal with hazard lights when a technical problem or other force majeure requires stopping in an expressway emergency stopping lane.

A road traffic violation involving failure to use headlights between 18:00 and 06:00, or when fog, smoke, dust, rain, or other poor weather restricts visibility. The provision sets a fine of 200,000 to 400,000 Vietnamese dong for this violation.

A road-traffic violation by a driver who does not use, or does not adequately use, vehicle lights between 6:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m., or when fog, smoke, dust, rain, or other bad weather restricts visibility.

id: failure to warn of a stopped vehicle on a highway traffic lane
ten: FAILURE TO WARN OF A STOPPED VEHICLE ON A HIGHWAY TRAFFIC LANE
mo_ta: A traffic violation involving failure to use hazard lights and place a warning sign or warning lamp at least 150 meters behind the vehicle when an emergency requires stopping on part of a highway traffic lane.

id: failure to warn of a vehicle stopped in a traffic lane
ten: FAILURE TO WARN OF A VEHICLE STOPPED IN A TRAFFIC LANE
mo_ta: The violation of failing to use hazard lights and place a warning sign or warning light at least 150 meters behind a vehicle stopped in an expressway traffic lane due to a technical problem or other force majeure.

id: failure to wear a motorcycle helmet
ten: FAILURE TO WEAR A MOTORCYCLE HELMET
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation in which a driver of a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle participates in road traffic without wearing a helmet intended for motorcycle or moped users.

id: failure to wear a seat belt in a moving car
ten: FAILURE TO WEAR A SEAT BELT IN A MOVING CAR
mo_ta: **Failure to Wear a Seat Belt in a Moving Car** is a traffic violation that occurs when a person travels in a moving car without wearing a safety belt provided for that seating position. Under Article 6 of Vietnam’s Decree 168/2024/ND-CP, the stated fine is **800,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese đồng**. A separate description lists a fine of **350,000 to 400,000 đồng**, which may reflect an earlier or otherwise different applicable regulation; the penalty depends on the rule in force at the time of the violation.
A road-traffic violation identified in Article 11: failing to yield as required

id: failure to yield at a marked pedestrian crossing
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD AT A MARKED PEDESTRIAN CROSSING
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation in which a driver fails to yield to a pedestrian or a wheelchair user with a disability crossing at a marked pedestrian crossing. Under Clause 5 of Article 8 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, it is punishable by a fine of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to yield at an intersection
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD AT AN INTERSECTION
mo_ta: A road traffic violation described in Decree 168/2024/ND-CP: failing to comply with right-of-way rules at an intersection. The text states that this violation is generally punishable by a fine of 200,000 to 400,000 Vietnamese dong, subject to the stated exceptions.

id: failure to yield at road intersections
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD AT ROAD INTERSECTIONS
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation described in Article 6(2) of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP: a driver fails to comply with right-of-way rules at a road intersection, subject to the exceptions stated in the provision.

id: failure to yield to a priority vehicle
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD TO A PRIORITY VEHICLE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation in which a driver of a specialized motorcycle fails to give way to a vehicle entitled to priority while it is signaling that it is on duty. Under Clause 6 of Article 8 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the violation is punishable by a fine of 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

id: failure to yield to an oncoming vehicle
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD TO AN ONCOMING VEHICLE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation involving failure to yield to an oncoming vehicle where required on a narrow or steep road, or at a place with an obstruction.

id: failure to yield to an overtaking vehicle
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD TO AN OVERTAKING VEHICLE
mo_ta: **FAILURE TO YIELD TO AN OVERTAKING VEHICLE** is a road-traffic violation that occurs when a driver fails to give way to a vehicle seeking to overtake, even though it is safe to do so. The descriptions identify the conduct under Article 9, Clause 2, and state that Article 6 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP sets a fine of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

id: failure to yield to non-motorized vehicles
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD TO NON-MOTORIZED VEHICLES
mo_ta: **FAILURE TO YIELD TO NON-MOTORIZED VEHICLES** is a road-traffic violation in which a driver, particularly when turning, fails to give priority to non-motorized vehicles traveling in a lane designated for them. Under Clause 5 of Article 8 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the violation is punishable by a fine of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: failure to yield to oncoming vehicles
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD TO ONCOMING VEHICLES
mo_ta: **FAILURE TO YIELD TO ONCOMING VEHICLES** is a road-traffic violation in which a driver does not give way to approaching traffic when required. It includes failing to yield while turning, or when passing on a narrow or steep road or where an obstacle makes yielding necessary. For covered vehicle operators, the violation is punishable by a fine of 200,000 to 400,000 VND.

id: failure to yield to or obstruct a priority vehicle
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD TO OR OBSTRUCT A PRIORITY VEHICLE
mo_ta: A road traffic violation in which a driver fails to give way to, or obstructs, a vehicle entitled to priority while it is signaling and performing its assigned duty. The decree specifies a fine of 6,000,000 to 8,000,000 Vietnamese dong for this conduct.

id: failure to yield to or obstruction of a priority vehicle
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD TO OR OBSTRUCTION OF A PRIORITY VEHICLE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation in which a driver fails to give way to, or obstructs, a vehicle entitled to priority that is signaling while on duty. The provision sets a fine of 4,000,000 to 6,000,000 Vietnamese dong for this conduct.

id: failure to yield to pedestrians and rudimentary vehicles
ten: FAILURE TO YIELD TO PEDESTRIANS AND RUDIMENTARY VEHICLES
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation in which a driver turning fails to give way to pedestrians and rudimentary vehicles crossing at a location without marked pedestrian-crossing lines.

A road traffic violation described in Decree 168/2024/ND-CP: a driver turns without yielding to oncoming vehicles or to pedestrians and non-motorized vehicles crossing where there is no pedestrian crossing marking.

**FAILURE TO YIELD WHILE TURNING** is a road-traffic violation committed when a motorcycle, moped, or similar-vehicle driver turns without yielding to oncoming vehicles, pedestrians, or non-motorized vehicles. This includes failing to yield to pedestrians or wheelchair users at a marked pedestrian crossing, to non-motorized vehicles traveling in their designated lane, and to pedestrians or non-motorized vehicles crossing where no pedestrian-crossing marking is present. Under Article 7, Clause 5 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the violation is punishable by a fine of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.
Fairs are among the activities that foreign-registered vehicles may enter Vietnam temporarily to attend.

id: false declaration or use of forged documents
ten: FALSE DECLARATION OR USE OF FORGED DOCUMENTS
mo_ta: The violation of making a false declaration or using forged papers or documents to obtain a replacement vehicle license plate or vehicle registration certificate, where the conduct does not reach the threshold for criminal prosecution.

id: false declaration or use of forged documents to obtain replacement vehicle documents
ten: FALSE DECLARATION OR USE OF FORGED DOCUMENTS TO OBTAIN REPLACEMENT VEHICLE DOCUMENTS
mo_ta: A violation involving knowingly making a false declaration or using forged papers to obtain a replacement vehicle registration plate, vehicle registration certificate, or certificate of technical safety and environmental protection inspection. The text states that this conduct is subject to fines under Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP when it does not reach the threshold for criminal prosecution.

id: false declaration or use of forged documents to reissue vehicle registration
ten: FALSE DECLARATION OR USE OF FORGED DOCUMENTS TO REISSUE VEHICLE REGISTRATION
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation consisting of falsely declaring information or using forged papers or documents to obtain a replacement vehicle license plate or vehicle registration certificate, where the conduct does not warrant criminal prosecution.

id: false declaration to obtain replacement vehicle documents
ten: FALSE DECLARATION TO OBTAIN REPLACEMENT VEHICLE DOCUMENTS
mo_ta: A violation in which a vehicle owner makes an untruthful declaration to obtain a replacement vehicle license plate or vehicle registration certificate, where the conduct does not warrant criminal prosecution.

id: falsification of ambulance driver image-recording data
ten: FALSIFICATION OF AMBULANCE DRIVER IMAGE-RECORDING DATA
mo_ta: A traffic violation involving the falsification of data from a driver-image recording device installed in an ambulance.
The violation of altering or falsifying information or data from a device installed in a motor vehicle to record images of its driver.
A road-traffic violation involving alteration or falsification of data from a driver-image recording device installed on a vehicle participating in traffic.

id: falsification of driver-image recording equipment data
ten: FALSIFICATION OF DRIVER-IMAGE RECORDING EQUIPMENT DATA
mo_ta: A violation consisting of altering or falsifying data from driver-image recording equipment installed in a qualifying passenger car.
The act of altering or falsifying information or data recorded by a vehicle’s journey-monitoring device, identified in the decree as a violation subject to a fine.
A violation consisting of falsifying data from the driver-image recording device installed in a covered vehicle.
A traffic violation involving altering or falsifying data recorded by a car’s journey-monitoring device.
FALSIFYING JOURNEY-MONITORING DEVICE DATA is a violation involving the alteration or falsification of data recorded by a journey-monitoring device installed in a vehicle.
The families of students are identified as responsible for guiding students in safe motorbike-riding skills.
The conversion or reissuance of an FE-class driving licence as a DE-class driving licence, with an additional certificate for operating specialized machinery for tractors weighing over 3,500 kg.
A ferry is a means of transport referenced as a route for vehicles crossing)

FERRY AND PONTOON BRIDGE CROSSING is the regulated road-traffic activity addressed by Article 23 of Law 36/2024/QH15. The article sets a descending order of priority for vehicles crossing by ferry or pontoon bridge, including vehicles carrying fresh food as a priority category. Under Clause 3, when vehicles descend onto, travel on, or leave a ferry, people may not remain inside them, except for the driver and specified groups of people.
FERRY CROSSING refers to the act of crossing by ferry. It is identified in Article 23 as a subject of traffic rules, whose heading covers ferry and pontoon-bridge crossings.
A moped-riding exercise in which students ride through a figure-eight pattern, one of the four patterns included in the safe-riding guidance.
An organization authorized to provide financial leases for vehicles; the text describes vehicles leased from such organizations.
A fine of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese dong prescribed for the specified license-plate violation.

FINE is a monetary penalty imposed for covered violations, including specified vehicle-condition violations committed by a driver. Under Clause 3, the fine ranges from 5,000,000 to 10,000,000 Vietnamese đồng. For certain violations, it is imposed in addition to the supplementary penalty of deprivation of the right to use a motor vehicle inspector certificate.

id: fine and driver's license point penalty
ten: FINE AND DRIVER'S LICENSE POINT PENALTY
mo_ta: The penalties specified in clause 13, Article 32 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for the described violation: a fine of 20,000,000 to 26,000,000 đồng for an individual vehicle owner, or 40,000,000 to 52,000,000 đồng for an organizational vehicle owner. Article 32 concerns penalties and deductions of driver's license points.

**FINE AND DRIVING-LICENSE POINT DEDUCTION** refers to the administrative sanctions applicable to specified vehicle-condition violations under Article 13 and to the listed cargo-vehicle violations under Article 21(1) of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. For the cargo-vehicle violations, the stated fine is **600,000–800,000 VND**, together with a deduction of driving-license points. The number of points deducted is not specified in the provided descriptions.
The sanctions described in the text: a fine of 6,000,000 to 8,000,000 Vietnamese dong and driver’s-license point deductions for specified violations.
A monetary penalty of 100,000 to 200,000 Vietnamese đồng imposed on drivers who commit the listed traffic violations.
The penalty of 500,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese đồng imposed on an individual who commits the specified loading-confirmation violation.
The penalty of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng imposed on an organization that commits the specified loading-confirmation violation.
The monetary penalty of 6,000,000 to 8,000,000 Vietnamese đồng imposed for transporting specified dangerous goods through tunnels at least 100 metres long.

id: fine for driving without valid compulsory motor-vehicle liability insurance
ten: FINE FOR DRIVING WITHOUT VALID COMPULSORY MOTOR-VEHICLE LIABILITY INSURANCE
mo_ta: A fine of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng for driving a car or a similar motorized four-wheel passenger or cargo vehicle without valid compulsory civil liability insurance for the vehicle owner.
An administrative penalty of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for failing to clean the vehicle or remove its hazardous-goods warning symbol after transportation ends.
An administrative penalty of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng specified in Clause 5, Article 12 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for the listed passenger helmet violations.

Fines for individual vehicle owners depend on the violation. Under Clause 12, an individual who owns a vehicle covered by the provision and commits the specified violation faces a fine of 16,000,000 to 18,000,000 Vietnamese dong. An individual vehicle owner who commits the specified license-plate violation faces a fine of 20,000,000 to 26,000,000 Vietnamese dong. These penalty ranges apply to different specified violations.

id: fine for invalid license use by certain motorcycle drivers
ten: FINE FOR INVALID LICENSE USE BY CERTAIN MOTORCYCLE DRIVERS
mo_ta: A penalty specified in Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, Article 18, Clause 5: a fine of 2,000,000 to 4,000,000 Vietnamese dong for a driver of a two-wheeled motorcycle with an engine capacity up to 125 cm3, an electric motor output up to 11 kW, or a similar vehicle who commits the specified violation.
A penalty of 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 VND specified for drivers of commercial vehicles transporting preschool children or students who commit the listed violations.
A fine of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng applies to drivers who commit the specified motorcycle helmet violations, subject to the stated exceptions.

id: fine for noncompliant school-transport vehicle color
ten: FINE FOR NONCOMPLIANT SCHOOL-TRANSPORT VEHICLE COLOR
mo_ta: A prescribed fine of 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for driving a school-transport vehicle that does not have the required paint color.
Clause 12 imposes a fine of 32,000,000 to 36,000,000 Vietnamese dong on an organization that owns a vehicle covered by the provision and commits the specified violation.

Organizations that own vehicles may face fines for specified violations. The stated penalty is 32,000,000 to 36,000,000 Vietnamese dong for one violation, and 40,000,000 to 52,000,000 Vietnamese dong for a specified license-plate violation. The descriptions do not identify the first violation or clarify whether the penalties apply to separate offenses.
An administrative penalty of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng specified for the listed passenger-transport traffic violations.
A monetary penalty of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 Vietnamese dong imposed on a vehicle operator for entering an area or road prohibited to that vehicle type, subject to the stated exceptions.
The decree prescribes a fine of 800,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for a driver who commits any of the specified towing-related violations.
An administrative fine of 600,000 to 800,000 Vietnamese đồng specified for the described violation under Article 20, Clause 3 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.
An administrative monetary penalty of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese dong imposed on a covered driver for any of the specified violations.
A monetary penalty of 600,000 to 800,000 Vietnamese đồng imposed on a driver who commits one of the violations listed in Clause 2, Article 8.

“FINE FOR THE VIOLATION” refers to the monetary penalty applicable to a driver, with the amount depending on the specific violation. The listed penalties range from 100,000 to 200,000 Vietnamese đồng and from 800,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese đồng. Under Article 20, Clause 3 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, failing to close a vehicle’s doors while it is moving is punishable by a fine of 600,000 to 800,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: fine for unauthorized priority signal devices
ten: FINE FOR UNAUTHORIZED PRIORITY SIGNAL DEVICES
mo_ta: An administrative penalty of 4,000,000 to 6,000,000 Vietnamese dong for the specified violation.
A monetary penalty of 200,000 to 400,000 Vietnamese dong for driving a vehicle designed to have a windshield when it has none or its windshield is broken and ineffective.

FINE IMPOSITION refers to monetary penalties for specified traffic violations in Vietnam. Depending on the violation, the fine ranges from 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng, or from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for a driver who commits one of the violations in the higher-penalty category.

The imposition of monetary fines on individual and organizational vehicle owners for specified road-traffic violations. Under Article 32, Clause 2, the fines range from 300,000 to 400,000 đồng for individuals and from 600,000 to 800,000 đồng for organizations.

The monetary penalty specified in Clause 2 of Article 16 for each listed violation, including operating a vehicle without required valid technical safety and environmental protection inspection documentation.

The fine of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng is the monetary penalty prescribed under Clause 5 of Article 20 for specified traffic violations. These include certain passenger pickup or drop-off violations; violations involving image-recording requirements for ambulance drivers, drivers, or passenger cars; and operating a specialized motorcycle outside its prescribed scope.

The **FINE OF 1,000,000 TO 2,000,000 VND** is the prescribed monetary penalty for several specified road-transport violations. These include violations under Clause 5 of Article 20, including the listed passenger-transport violations; a specified violation by a driver of a road motor vehicle bearing a foreign registration plate; and covered Article 27 violations committed while transporting preschool children or students in commercial vehicles, including vehicles used for pickup and drop-off. The same penalty range is also specified for the driver-image-recording device violation and the listed vehicle-condition violations.
A monetary penalty prescribed for the specified tire-related vehicle violation.

**FINE OF 1,000,000–2,000,000 VND** is an administrative monetary penalty. It is prescribed by Article 20, Clause 5, for specified passenger-transport violations, and by Article 8, Clause 4, of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for a specified violation. The descriptions do not identify the violations, so the applicable provision depends on the conduct involved.
The fine prescribed for a driver who receives or delivers goods on an expressway.
The monetary penalty prescribed for an inspection facility that commits one of the specified violations, including failing to update vehicle records as required.

The **FINE OF 10,000,000 TO 15,000,000 VIETNAMESE ĐỒNG** is a monetary penalty prescribed for covered establishments that conduct testing or certification contrary to regulations. The same penalty range is specified for vehicle inspection facilities that commit one of the listed violations.
The monetary penalty specified for the listed violations by vehicle and parts testing and certification establishments.

The **fine of 10,000,000 to 20,000,000 Vietnamese đồng** is the administrative monetary penalty stipulated in Article 39, Clause 4, for specified violations by driver training institutions and driving test centers.
The **fine of 10,000,000 to 20,000,000 VND** is the monetary penalty prescribed by Article 39, Clause 4, for the covered violations involving driver training and driving tests.
The monetary penalty prescribed for the specified violations by driving training establishments and driving test centers.
The monetary penalty specified for the listed traffic violations by covered vehicle drivers.

The fine of 100,000 to 200,000 Vietnamese dong is the monetary penalty prescribed for certain traffic violations by drivers of bicycles, motorized bicycles, and other rudimentary vehicles in road tunnels. Under Article 9, Clause 1 of Decree 168/2024/ND-CP, it applies to drivers who fail to slow down or stop and yield as required.
The financial penalty specified for failing to guide passengers to occupy the prescribed positions in the vehicle.

The **FINE OF 100,000 TO 200,000 VND** is the monetary penalty prescribed for the specified road traffic violations, including the listed alcohol-related violation. It applies to the relevant drivers and operators of bicycles, motorized bicycles, and other rudimentary vehicles, as set out in Clause 1. The fine ranges from 100,000 to 200,000 Vietnamese đồng.
The monetary penalty specified in Article 9, Clause 1 for operators committing one of the listed traffic violations.

The monetary penalty specified for transporting dangerous goods without a permit, with an expired permit, or contrary to the permit's requirements, except for the cited violations in Article 20, clause 6, point a.

The **FINE OF 12,000,000 TO 14,000,000 VND** is the monetary penalty imposed on drivers who commit the specified highway stopping or parking violations, or another traffic violation covered by the applicable list.
The monetary penalty range specified for a driver who uses a non-commercial passenger car to carry people for payment or under a contract or booking.
A monetary penalty imposed for one of the listed violations.
The monetary penalty specified in clause 3 for any of the listed permit-related violations involving oversized or overweight goods.

The **fine of 13,000,000 to 15,000,000 Vietnamese đồng** is the monetary penalty prescribed in Clause 3, Article 22 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for carrying oversized or overweight cargo on a route different from the route authorized by a valid circulation permit.
The monetary penalty range stated for the specified violations: 13,000,000 to 15,000,000 Vietnamese dong.
The monetary penalty specified for operators who commit one of the listed violations while driving a vehicle.

The **fine of 150,000 to 250,000 Vietnamese dong** is the monetary penalty specified in Article 9, Clause 2, for listed traffic violations by bicycle and motorized-bicycle operators. It applies to the vehicle operators covered by Article 9.
The monetary penalty prescribed for covered drivers who fail to obey traffic signal lights under Clause 2 of Article 9 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.
The monetary penalty specified in Article 11, clause 1, for the listed traffic violations
The monetary penalty specified for the listed violation, including operating a vehicle without required signaling.
The monetary penalty specified for the described post-accident violations.

The **fine of 18,000,000 to 20,000,000 Vietnamese đồng** is the prescribed monetary penalty for the specified violations, including violations committed by drivers of vehicle types covered by Article 6, Clause 9, listed expressway violations, and operating a vehicle on a road while the driver’s body contains narcotics or other stimulants prohibited by law.

The **FINE OF 18,000,000 TO 20,000,000 VND** is the monetary penalty prescribed under Article 8, Clause 9, for covered drivers—including drivers of cars and motorized four-wheeled passenger or cargo vehicles—who commit specified violations of driver’s-license requirements.
The monetary penalty prescribed for the specified violations in clause 9 of Article 8.

The **FINE OF 2,000,000 TO 3,000,000 VIETNAMESE DONG** is a monetary penalty specified for several categories of violations. These include certain failures to comply with requirements in a circulation permit, subject to the applicable exceptions; operating a covered student-transport vehicle without the required manager or with too few managers; the listed driving-instructor violations under Article 39, Clause 1; and the listed road-traffic violations committed by drivers of motorcycles, mopeds, and similar vehicles under Clause 6 of Article 7 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. The applicable violation and legal provision determine which conduct falls within this fine range.

**FINE OF 2,000,000 TO 3,000,000 VIETNAMESE ĐỒNG** is a prescribed monetary penalty range for drivers, vehicle operators, and other persons responsible for specified road-traffic violations. Depending on the applicable provision, it may apply to entering a prohibited area or road; operating a truck whose cargo-bed dimensions differ from those recorded on its vehicle inspection certificate; specified driving-instructor violations; failing to ensure safety when a car breaks down at a road–rail level crossing; vehicle-registration violations under Article 14, Clause 2; using a horn that does not meet the technical standards for the vehicle type; and vehicle-condition violations under Article 13, Clause 4. The applicable fine depends on the particular violation.

The **fine of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 VND** is a monetary penalty prescribed for several distinct violations. Depending on the applicable provision, it may apply to a vehicle-condition violation under Article 13; a passenger threatening or infringing another person’s health aboard a vehicle under Article 33; operating a temporarily registered vehicle outside its permitted area, route, or period; or unauthorized transport-badge use by specified four-wheeled motor vehicles. It also covers the Article 13, clause 4 violation involving the display or installation of vehicle insignia resembling those of government, diplomatic, or international organizations, as well as other specified violations by drivers or driving instructors, including a badge-related violation by an instructor.
