The monetary penalty prescribed for the specified failure to slow down or stop and yield when entering a priority road or main road

The **fine of 2,000,000 to 4,000,000 Vietnamese đồng** is the specified monetary penalty for the listed traffic violations. These include dragging materials or waste onto a roadway in a way that endangers traffic, driving without required written approval or a permit, and violating the listed traffic-related environmental-protection requirements.
The monetary penalty specified in Clause 2 of Article 17 for any of the listed violations.
The monetary penalty specified for the listed driving-instructor violation.
The financial penalty prescribed for a driver who commits one of the listed traffic-rule violations and causes a traffic accident.
The monetary penalty prescribed in Article 13, Clause 8 for the specified vehicle registration plate violation
The monetary penalty specified for the listed vehicle license-plate violations.
A monetary penalty specified for any one of the listed violations in Article 13.
The monetary penalty specified for the violations described in Article 39, Clause 5, including driver training that does not follow the prescribed content, program, or curriculum.
The monetary penalty specified in Article 39(5) of Decree 168/2024/ND-CP for covered violations by a driving training establishment or driver testing center.
A monetary penalty imposed on individuals who commit one of the specified violations in Article 12, Clause 2.

The **fine of 200,000 to 300,000 Vietnamese dong** applies to the covered violations of failing to carry a vehicle registration certificate or required substitute documents, and failing to carry a valid compulsory civil liability insurance certificate while operating a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle for transport business.
The monetary penalty specified in Clause 2 of Article 18 for driving a motorcycle, motorbike, or similar vehicle without a valid compulsory civil liability insurance certificate.
The monetary penalty specified for the listed traffic violations committed by motorcycle, moped, and similar vehicle drivers.
A monetary penalty specified in Article 7 for a driver who commits one of the listed violations, including reversing a three-wheeled motorcycle without checking around the vehicle or signaling.
The **FINE OF 200,000 TO 400,000 VND** is a monetary penalty specified in Article 7 for a driver who commits a listed road-traffic violation, including the stated minimum-speed violation.
The monetary penalty prescribed for covered road traffic violations by operators of motorbikes and similar vehicles.

A monetary penalty prescribed by Article 13, Clause 5 for any of the listed violations, including operating a transport-business vehicle whose service life does not meet the conditions of its registered business type.
The monetary penalty prescribed by Article 37, Clause 3 of Decree 168/2024/ND-CP for the specified traffic violations.

The **fine of 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese dong** is the monetary penalty prescribed under Article 8, Clause 6 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for specified violations. These include listed goods-transport driving violations, violations involving journey-monitoring devices, and listed violations by drivers of automobiles or similar vehicles, including failure to carry the required temporary import–re-export road transport declaration.

The fine of 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese đồng is the monetary penalty prescribed for a specified transport-permit violation and for listed violations by drivers of specialized motor vehicles. It also applies to listed violations involving goods carried in a passenger vehicle under Article 20, including violations specified in Clause 6 of that article.

The **FINE OF 3,000,000 TO 5,000,000 VND** is a monetary penalty prescribed for several categories of violations. These include certain improper stops or parking on an expressway—such as failing to use hazard signals or place a warning behind the vehicle, as specified in Article 8, Clause 6—and violations by drivers of cars or similar vehicles registered to operate in the specified economic zones, under Article 38. The same fine applies to failure to comply with circulation-permit requirements, subject to the exceptions in Article 34; the listed passenger-vehicle journey-monitoring violations; and either of the driving violations listed in Article 20, Clause 6.
The monetary penalty range specified in Article 37(3) for the listed violations.

The monetary penalty prescribed by Clause 11 of Article 6 for the listed violations, including driving with a blood alcohol concentration above 80 milligrams per 100 milliliters of blood or a breath alcohol concentration above 0.4 milligrams per liter.
FINE OF 30,000,000 TO 40,000,000 VND is the monetary penalty range for drivers who commit one of the specified violations, including driving with prohibited narcotics or stimulants in their body.
The monetary penalty specified in Article 9, Clause 3 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for the listed traffic violations.

The **fine of 300,000 to 400,000 Vietnamese đồng** is prescribed for transporting goods that are arranged or fastened unsafely, or in a manner that endangers people or vehicles in traffic. Article 18(3) also specifies this fine for the listed driving violations, subject to the stated exception.

The **FINE OF 300,000 TO 400,000 VND** is the monetary penalty specified in Clause 3 of Article 9 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for the listed road-traffic violations involving requirements or conditions for motor-vehicle drivers.
A monetary penalty of 30,000,000 to 35,000,000 Vietnamese đồng specified for the violation.
The monetary penalty prescribed for individuals who commit the specified official-duty-related violations.
The monetary penalty specified for individuals who commit one of the violations described in the text.

The **fine of 4,000,000 to 6,000,000 Vietnamese dong** is the monetary penalty specified for several listed violations. It is stated in Clause 5 for certain violations and also applies to the listed traffic violations, including motorcycle, moped, and similar-vehicle license plate violations specified in Clause 3 of Article 14.

The **FINE OF 4,000,000 TO 6,000,000 VIETNAMESE ĐỒNG** is a monetary penalty prescribed for drivers who commit specified traffic violations. The descriptions associate this fine with violations listed in Article 6, Clause 5; certain violations involving the transport of dangerous goods by car; a vehicle-inspection violation under Article 13, Clause 6; and failure to obey a traffic signal.

The **FINE OF 4,000,000 TO 6,000,000 VND** is a monetary penalty imposed on a driver for specified traffic violations under Article 6, Clause 5, including entering a prohibited area or road. The fine ranges from 4,000,000 to 6,000,000 Vietnamese dong.
The monetary penalty specified in Article 6, Clause 5 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for the listed vehicle driver violations, including driving 10–20 km/h above the prescribed speed limit.
The **FINE OF 4,000,000–6,000,000 VND** is the monetary penalty range specified in Clause 5 of Article 6 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for drivers who commit one of the listed violations.
The monetary penalty prescribed by Article 34, Clause 5, for either refusal to comply with the specified inspection or tactics used to evade detection.
The monetary penalty specified in Clause 5 of Article 34 for the stated road-weight-limit violation.
**FINE OF 40,000,000 TO 50,000,000 VND** is an administrative monetary penalty prescribed for driving test centers that commit one or more of the specified violations covered by Article 34.
The monetary penalty specified in Article 26, Clause 10 for the listed violations.

The **FINE OF 400,000 TO 600,000 VIETNAMESE DONG** is a monetary penalty for a driver who commits certain traffic-rule violations listed under Article 11, Clause 2 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. These include unauthorized installation or use of signal equipment reserved for priority vehicles; the descriptions do not specify every violation covered.

The **fine of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng** is prescribed for several traffic violations. These include the violation specified in Clause 2 of Article 11; a person aged 16 to under 18 operating a motorcycle or similar vehicle; carrying two people on a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle except in specified circumstances; driving at low speed without keeping to the right side of the carriageway and thereby obstructing traffic; the covered violation of driver requirements; and entering or leaving a stopping or parking position without signaling to notify other drivers.

**FINE OF 400,000 TO 600,000 VND** is the monetary penalty range prescribed for various listed road-traffic and transport violations. It applies to certain vehicle-condition violations under Article 13, Clause 2, and Article 14, Clause 1, including operating a vehicle without functioning signal lights. The range also covers specified animal-related violations under Article 11, Clause 2; warning-sign violations by drivers; a described violation by pedestrians; certain stopping or parking violations; and failure to comply with an on-duty official’s request for an alcohol-concentration test.

The same penalty range is specified for listed violations by passengers on motorcycles and similar vehicles under Article 12, Clause 5, and for transport violations under Article 36, Clause 2, including carrying luggage or goods beyond a vehicle’s permitted load. It applies to the particular violations identified in the relevant provisions, rather than to every violation in those categories.
The monetary penalty prescribed for the specified road-traffic rule violation.

The **FINE OF 400,000–600,000 VND** is a monetary penalty specified for several listed traffic violations. These include violations under Article 8, clause 1; the described vehicle-lighting violation; the described underage motorcycle-driving violation; stopping and parking violations under Article 7, clause 2; and the helmet-related violation described in Article 9, clause 4 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. The penalty is 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng.
The monetary penalty specified for the listed driving-examination violations

The **fine of 5,000,000 to 10,000,000 Vietnamese đồng** is the monetary penalty prescribed by Clause 3 of Article 39 for the listed violations. It applies to the violation of using a driver-training vehicle that lacks an auxiliary brake or has an ineffective auxiliary brake.

The **FINE OF 5,000,000 TO 10,000,000 VND** is the monetary penalty prescribed under Article 39, Clause 3 for specified violations, including violations of driving-test regulations and one or more listed driver-training regulation violations.
The monetary penalty prescribed by clause 3 for the specified violations of driver-training and testing regulations
The monetary penalty specified in Clause 6 of Article 21 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for the listed violations involving goods-transport vehicles.
The fine of 5,000,000 to 7,000,000 Vietnamese đồng is the monetary penalty prescribed for the specified cargo-vehicle overloading violation.
A monetary penalty specified for one or more of the violations covered by Article 21, ranging from 5,000,000 to 7,000,000 Vietnamese dong.
The monetary penalty prescribed for the specified violation, ranging from 5,000,000 to 7,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

FINE OF 500,000 TO 1,000,000 VND is the monetary penalty specified for covered drivers who commit a listed control-badge violation or operate a vehicle that does not meet urban circulation sanitation requirements.

The **FINE OF 6,000,000 TO 8,000,000 VIETNAMESE DONG** is a monetary penalty prescribed for several listed road traffic violations. These include violations by specialized motor vehicle operators, failing to yield to or obstructing a priority vehicle using signals while performing its duty, the described motorcycle license violation, and an Article 7 violation involving exceeding the speed limit by more than 20 km/h.
The monetary penalty prescribed for qualifying motorcycle drivers who commit one of the violations listed in clause 7 of Article 18.

**FINE OF 6,000,000 TO 8,000,000 VND** is the monetary penalty specified for an individual or driver who commits a covered road-traffic violation. The listed violations include failure to obey traffic directions and the described alcohol-concentration violation. The penalty is cited under Article 6, Clause 6, and Article 8, Clause 7, of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.
A monetary penalty specified for the stated driving violation, with a fine ranging from 6,000,000 to 8,000,000 Vietnamese dong.
The monetary penalty specified for failing to secure a cargo vehicle’s rear or side door while the vehicle is moving.

The **FINE OF 600,000 TO 800,000 VIETNAMESE DONG** is a monetary penalty prescribed for several traffic violations under Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. These include specified stopping and parking violations under Clause 2, Article 8; allowing a person to lie in a hammock while the vehicle is moving; carrying luggage or goods that exceed the vehicle’s outer dimensions under Clause 3, Article 20; and the violations listed in Clause 3, Article 7.

A fine of 600,000 to 800,000 Vietnamese đồng is prescribed for several specified traffic violations. These include certain lane-change and turning violations, carrying more people in a vehicle cab than regulations allow, failing to display a route as required, and specified violations involving luggage and cargo. The same fine range is also prescribed for other listed traffic violations under the referenced provisions, including Article 6, Clause 2 and Article 7, Clause 3.

**FINE OF 600,000 TO 800,000 VND** is the administrative monetary penalty prescribed under Clause 3 of Article 20 for a driver or vehicle operator who commits one of the specified traffic violations. These include operating a passenger transport vehicle without the required onboard service staff.
A monetary penalty range specified for one or more of the violations covered by Article 20
An administrative monetary penalty prescribed for a driver who commits one of the listed traffic violations, including an improper lane change. The amount is 600,000 to 800,000 Vietnamese đồng.
The monetary penalty prescribed for the described overloading violation by a goods-transport vehicle.
Administrative fine specified in Article 21 for certain violations by drivers of goods-transport vehicles; the excerpt does not specify the individual violations.
The monetary penalty specified in Article 7, Clause 9 for a driver who operates a vehicle on a road while carrying narcotics or another stimulant prohibited by law in their body.
The **FINE OF 8,000,000 TO 10,000,000 VIETNAMESE ĐỒNG** is the monetary penalty prescribed under Clause 4 of Article 37 for an individual who fails to perform the specified assigned duties.

“FINE OF 8,000,000 TO 10,000,000 VND” is the administrative monetary penalty prescribed for a driver or other individual who commits a specified violation under Clause 9 of Article 7 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. The applicable fine ranges from 8,000,000 to 10,000,000 Vietnamese dong; Article 40(1) also identifies this penalty in connection with a listed violation.

The **fine of 8,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese dong** is the monetary penalty specified for the violation described in Article 21. It also applies to unauthorized vehicle operation, except for the violation referred to in point b, clause 7, Article 6 of the decree.
The **FINE OF 8,000,000 TO 12,000,000 VIETNAMESE ĐỒNG** is the monetary penalty specified under Clause 8 of Article 21 for the listed cargo-vehicle and goods-transport violations.

The **FINE OF 8,000,000 TO 12,000,000 VND** is the monetary penalty prescribed for each applicable violation among those listed under Article 21, including the specified cargo-transport violations, overweight trailer-towing violation, and vehicle-overloading violation under Clause 8 of Article 21 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.

The **fine of 800,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese dong** is the monetary penalty specified for certain road-traffic violations. It applies to one of the violations covered by Article 21, to specified child-passenger safety violations committed by drivers, and to the listed violations by drivers of specialized motorcycles under Article 8, Clause 3.

The **FINE OF 800,000 TO 1,000,000 VIETNAMESE ĐỒNG** is the specified monetary penalty for the covered violations: driving 10–20 km/h above the prescribed speed limit; listed technical-condition violations involving specialized motorcycles; listed vehicle-condition violations under Article 16; and the relevant specialized-vehicle operating-condition violation.

“FINE OF 800,000 TO 1,000,000 VND” is a prescribed monetary penalty range for drivers who commit specified violations. The range is associated with violations including the trailer-towing violation under Article 21, Clause 2; the lighting violation under Article 6, Clause 3 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP; listed violations by drivers of motorcycles, mopeds, and similar vehicles under Article 7, Clause 4; and driving without wearing a seat belt. The applicable violation depends on the relevant provision.
The monetary penalty specified for a driver who commits the speeding violation described in the text.

The **FINE OF VND 1,000,000 TO VND 2,000,000** is an administrative monetary penalty prescribed for the specified violations. These include picking up or dropping off passengers at an unauthorized location, failing to yield as specified, and violating the driver-image recording equipment requirement described in Clause 5 of Article 20. The applicable fine ranges from VND 1,000,000 to VND 2,000,000.
A monetary penalty range specified in Article 13 for certain vehicle-condition violations.
The monetary penalty prescribed by Article 22 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for transporting oversized or overweight goods contrary to the type of goods specified in a valid circulation permit.
The monetary penalty specified in Article 40, clause 4, for an inspection facility committing one of the listed violations.
The monetary penalty specified for a driver who commits the stated violation
A monetary penalty ranging from VND 2,000,000 to VND 3,000,000 for one of the specified vehicle-equipment violations.
The monetary penalty prescribed for the listed violations in Article 6, Clause 4, including the specified prohibited U-turn behavior.
The **FINE OF VND 2,000,000–4,000,000** is the monetary penalty specified in Clause 5 for a covered motorcycle driver licensing violation. It ranges from 2,000,000 to 4,000,000 Vietnamese dong.
The **FINE OF VND 3,000,000 TO VND 5,000,000** is the monetary penalty specified under Article 20 of the decree for a driver who fails to slow down or yield as required.
An administrative fine specified for drivers of commercial vehicles transporting preschool children or students, including vehicles combining commercial transport with their pickup and drop-off.
The monetary penalty specified for an individual who commits one of the violations described in the provision.
A monetary penalty specified for the listed goods-transport vehicle violations, including the stated excess-payload violations.
A monetary penalty imposed on individuals or organizations committing the specified road transport regulatory violations.

id: fine schedule for individual vehicle owners
ten: FINE SCHEDULE FOR INDIVIDUAL VEHICLE OWNERS
mo_ta: Article 32 sets fines of 2,000,000 to 4,000,000 Vietnamese dong per person carried over the permitted capacity, capped at 75,000,000 dong, for an individual vehicle owner in the specified circumstances.

id: fine schedule for organizational vehicle owners
ten: FINE SCHEDULE FOR ORGANIZATIONAL VEHICLE OWNERS
mo_ta: Article 32 sets fines of 4,000,000 to 8,000,000 Vietnamese dong per person carried over the permitted capacity, capped at 150,000,000 dong, for an organizational vehicle owner in the specified circumstances.
A monetary penalty of 800,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese dong for the specified expired-inspection-document violation.
An administrative fine of 300,000 to 400,000 Vietnamese đồng prescribed for one of the violations listed in Article 18(3), including failure to carry a required inspection certificate.
A fine of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese dong prescribed for either of the specified identification-card violations.
A fine of 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for one of the specified cargo-transport vehicle violations.

The monetary penalty specified in the excerpt: 10,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese dong for an individual vehicle owner, and 20,000,000 to 24,000,000 Vietnamese dong for an organizational vehicle owner.
An administrative fine of 8,000,000 to 10,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for any one of the violations listed in Article 34, Clause 3.
A monetary penalty of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 Vietnamese đồng prescribed by Clause 5 of Article 8 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for the specified road-traffic violations.
A statutory monetary penalty for the specified vehicle-owner violations: 4,000,000 to 6,000,000 Vietnamese dong for an individual, or 8,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese dong for an organization.
Monetary penalties imposed on individuals or organizations that commit the specified violations; Article 39 notes that additional penalties may also apply.

The penalties specified for the violations include fines of 4,000,000 to 6,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for individuals and 8,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for organizations, as well as driver’s-license point deductions under the provision.

id: fines and driving licence point deductions
ten: FINES AND DRIVING LICENCE POINT DEDUCTIONS
mo_ta: The penalties described in the excerpt: a fine of 5,000,000 to 10,000,000 Vietnamese dong and deduction of driving licence points for specified violations.
Penalties addressed in Article 32 for vehicle owners who violate road-traffic regulations. The excerpt gives fines of 200,000–300,000 đồng for individuals and 400,000–600,000 đồng for organizations.

**FINES AND DRIVING-LICENSE POINT DEDUCTIONS** are the administrative penalties specified in Article 7 for covered road-traffic violations. Depending on the violation, the penalties include fines of 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese đồng or 8,000,000 to 10,000,000 Vietnamese đồng, as well as deductions of driving-license points for specified violations.
Penalties applied to drivers who commit the specified vehicle-condition violations, including supplementary measures in addition to monetary fines.
Monetary penalties of 500,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for individuals who commit one of the specified violations.
The provision prescribes a fine of 8,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for an organization that owns a specified vehicle and commits the registration-change violation.
Monetary penalties of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for organizations that commit one of the specified violations.
Monetary penalties specified for organizing illegal races: 40 million to 50 million Vietnamese dong for an individual and 80 million to 100 million Vietnamese dong for an organization.

The provision sets fines of 4,000,000 to 6,000,000 Vietnamese dong for individuals and 8,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese dong for transport business organizations that commit the specified violation.

**FINES FOR THE VIOLATION** include a fine of **VND 1,000,000–2,000,000** for failing to guide preschool children or students to sit in designated positions in a vehicle. The listed penalties also include **VND 10,000,000–12,000,000 for individuals** and **VND 20,000,000–24,000,000 for transport businesses or transport-support service organizations**. These amounts are presented for different violation contexts.

FINES FOR VEHICLE OWNERS vary according to the applicable violation. Under Article 32, Clause 13, an individual vehicle owner may be fined 20,000,000–26,000,000 Vietnamese đồng, while an organizational vehicle owner may be fined 40,000,000–52,000,000 Vietnamese đồng. For another listed act, the fine is 28,000,000–30,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for an individual and 56,000,000–60,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for an organization.

**Fines for Vehicle-Owner Violations** under Article 32 vary by the applicable clause and whether the vehicle owner is an individual or an organization. For the specified violations involving covered vehicles—including cars, specialized motorcycles, or similar vehicles—the fines are:

- **Clause 11:** VND 10,000,000–12,000,000 for an individual owner and VND 20,000,000–24,000,000 for an organizational owner.
- **Clause 14:** VND 28,000,000–30,000,000 for an individual owner and VND 56,000,000–60,000,000 for an organizational owner.
- **Clause 16:** VND 65,000,000–75,000,000 for an individual owner and VND 130,000,000–150,000,000 for an organizational owner.
The monetary penalties prescribed for inspection facilities that commit one of the specified violations.
The monetary penalty range imposed on driver training establishments for the specified contract-related violations
Administrative fines of 3,000,000 to 4,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for individuals and 6,000,000 to 8,000,000 đồng for organizations committing the listed violations.
Administrative monetary penalties of 10,000,000 to 20,000,000 Vietnamese đồng imposed on driver training establishments or driving test centers for specified violations.

id: fining a vehicle owner for a road traffic violation
ten: FINING A VEHICLE OWNER FOR A ROAD TRAFFIC VIOLATION
mo_ta: The imposition of a fine of 65,000,000–75,000,000 Vietnamese đồng on an individual vehicle owner, or 130,000,000–150,000,000 Vietnamese đồng on an organizational vehicle owner, for the specified conduct.

id: fining an individual for the specified violation
ten: FINING AN INDIVIDUAL FOR THE SPECIFIED VIOLATION
mo_ta: Imposing a fine of 500,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese đồng on an individual who commits one of the specified violations.

id: fining an organization for the specified violation
ten: FINING AN ORGANIZATION FOR THE SPECIFIED VIOLATION
mo_ta: Imposing a fine of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng on an organization that commits one of the specified violations.
A fire that causes unsafe conditions for road traffic.
Activities to prevent and fight fires, cited as a purpose for stopping road traffic vehicles for inspection and control.

id: fire prevention, fighting and rescue police
ten: FIRE PREVENTION, FIGHTING AND RESCUE POLICE
mo_ta: The police force responsible for fire prevention, firefighting, and rescue; its fire engines performing firefighting duties are described as priority vehicles that use red flashing lights.

id: fire prevention, fire fighting and rescue police
ten: FIRE PREVENTION, FIRE FIGHTING AND RESCUE POLICE
mo_ta: The police force responsible for fire prevention, firefighting, and rescue. Its fire engines are listed as priority vehicles when responding to firefighting duties.

id: fire prevention, firefighting and rescue police
ten: FIRE PREVENTION, FIREFIGHTING AND RESCUE POLICE
mo_ta: FIRE PREVENTION, FIREFIGHTING AND RESCUE POLICE is the police force responsible for fire prevention, firefighting, and rescue. Its fire trucks are equipped with priority-vehicle signal devices, including a red flashing light and a priority siren, as specified in the decree.
A place reserved for fire trucks to draw water, identified as a place where stopping and parking are prohibited.

FIREFIGHTING DUTY is an assignment or operation to respond to and extinguish fires. It may be carried out by the Fire Prevention, Fighting and Rescue Police or by other mobilized forces. During the duty, their designated fire engines or fire trucks may operate as priority vehicles and use flashing red priority lights.
A place reserved for fire engines to access water, where parking is prohibited.
Fires are among the emergencies traffic police participate in preventing.
Immediate initial care provided to victims at the scene of a road traffic accident.

id: five-meter area from an intersection edge
ten: FIVE-METER AREA FROM AN INTERSECTION EDGE
mo_ta: The area extending up to five meters from the edge of a road intersection, where stopping and parking are prohibited.

The violation of operating fixed-route passenger transport without a transport order, failing to carry it, or carrying one with incomplete information or without the required confirmation from the departure and arrival bus stations. The stated fine is 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

A supplementary administrative penalty that temporarily removes an individual’s or organization’s right to use a license or practice certificate. If the document has not been temporarily seized when the penalty decision is made, the deprivation period begins when the violator presents it to the competent sanctioning authority for seizure.
A required corrective action to latch and secure the rear and side doors of a vehicle’s cargo box.
A road vehicle operator's act of fleeing after failing to comply with a signal or order to stop.

id: fleeing after causing a road traffic accident
ten: FLEEING AFTER CAUSING A ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENT
mo_ta: The act of leaving after causing a road traffic accident to evade responsibility, prohibited by Article 9 of Law 36/2024/QH15.
A circumstance that may extend the deadline for registering a vehicle with an auctioned plate by up to six additional months.
A FORCE MAJEURE CIRCUMSTANCE is an unavoidable circumstance other than a technical incident or failure that may compel a driver to stop or park a vehicle in a road tunnel.
Unavoidable incidents affecting road travel, identified as a circumstance in which road traffic safety measures may be required.

id: forced parking partly in a traffic lane or in a prohibited area
ten: FORCED PARKING PARTLY IN A TRAFFIC LANE OR IN A PROHIBITED AREA
mo_ta: Parking required by a technical failure or other force majeure, either partly in a traffic lane or in a place where parking is not permitted.
A stop required by a technical failure or other force majeure, where the vehicle must stop partly in a traffic lane or in a place where stopping or parking is prohibited.

Foreign agencies and organizations are entities authorized by a competent Vietnamese authority to operate within Vietnam. Vehicles they temporarily import are subject to revocation of their registration certificates and license plates if they are re-exported, transferred to a new owner, or destroyed.

A **FOREIGN BANK BRANCH** may hold a vehicle as mortgagee or collateral holder and may retain the vehicle’s original registration certificate. When the original certificate is held by the branch, the applicable decree allows or requires the vehicle operator to carry a certified copy of the registration certificate together with the branch’s original receipt. Where the vehicle is mortgaged to the branch, a relevant confirmation document may also be required alongside the registration certificate or its certified copy.

Foreign bank branches may hold or retain a vehicle’s original registration certificate. When the original is held by such a branch, the applicable provision identifies an officially certified or authenticated copy of the registration certificate, accompanied by the branch’s original receipt, as supporting documentation. These documents may be required for the vehicle to participate in traffic or in connection with a replacement document, as specified by the decree.
Consular agencies in Vietnam whose official dispatch may state the reasons and purpose for a vehicle to participate in traffic in Vietnam.

Foreign Diplomatic Missions in Vietnam are diplomatic missions representing foreign countries in Vietnam. Their official dispatches or diplomatic notes may state the reasons and purposes for vehicles to participate in traffic in Vietnam.
A foreign national who drives a foreign motor vehicle participating in road traffic in Vietnam.

Foreign Drivers are foreign nationals who operate foreign motor vehicles or other vehicles participating in traffic in Vietnam. They must hold an appropriate, valid driving licence and comply with the applicable conditions set out in Article 32. Their driving activities are subject to management and inspection, including the reporting of legal violations and traffic accidents.

id: foreign drivers of foreign motor vehicles
ten: FOREIGN DRIVERS OF FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLES
mo_ta: Foreign nationals driving foreign motor vehicles in Vietnam; violations or traffic accidents involving them may give rise to costs that responsible parties must address.
Foreign nationals driving foreign motor vehicles while participating in traffic in Vietnam, the activity to which the decree’s management, inspection, and incident-reporting provisions apply.
Foreign employees of an international organization who hold that organization’s diplomatic identity card; the provision describes QT-symbol vehicle plates as being issued for their vehicles.
A foreign national taking the road traffic legal knowledge examination; if accompanied by an interpreter, the examinee and interpreter sign or fingerprint the examination record
Visitors from abroad traveling to Vietnam who may be assigned Traffic Police escorts under rules prescribed by the Minister of Public Security.

Foreign individuals may be issued license plates for their vehicles with a white background, black characters and numbers, and the symbol “NN,” except for those specified in point g. For foreign individuals’ temporarily imported vehicles, the registration certificate and license plates are subject to revocation if the vehicle is re-exported, transferred to a new owner, or destroyed.

id: foreign motor vehicle convoy traffic and reporting
ten: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLE CONVOY TRAFFIC AND REPORTING
mo_ta: The activity described is foreign motor vehicle convoys participating in traffic in Vietnam, with their activities monitored and reported in real time through a mobile application.

**FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLE INCIDENTS** are incidents caused by, associated with, or involving foreign motor vehicles while they participate in traffic in Vietnam. Provincial and municipal authorities are required to report these incidents, and the Ministry of Public Security must report them to the designated agencies and representatives.

id: foreign motor vehicle road participation in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLE ROAD PARTICIPATION IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: The participation in road traffic in Vietnam of foreign motor vehicles driven by foreigners, covered by a database managed by the Ministry of Public Security.

id: foreign motor vehicle road traffic in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLE ROAD TRAFFIC IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: The activity of foreign nationals driving foreign motor vehicles in traffic in Vietnam, subject to Vietnamese road traffic order and safety laws and requirements to carry and present valid driving documents

id: foreign motor vehicle tourism in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLE TOURISM IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: The activity of organizing foreign visitors to bring foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism, addressed by the appendix’s approval-related forms.

id: foreign motor vehicle traffic in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLE TRAFFIC IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLE TRAFFIC IN VIETNAM refers to the participation of foreign motor vehicles in traffic within Vietnam, including bringing the vehicles into the country and taking them out afterward. This activity may require arranging the vehicles and traffic guides and displaying an identifying logo or flag. Participants must comply with applicable laws on security and public order.

id: foreign motor vehicle use in traffic in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLE USE IN TRAFFIC IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: The activity of a foreign person driving a foreign motor vehicle in traffic in Vietnam. The activity is subject to Vietnamese road traffic laws, and the driver must carry and present a temporary import and re-export customs declaration for the vehicle when requested by a competent authority.

id: foreign motor vehicles brought into vietnam for tourism
ten: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLES BROUGHT INTO VIETNAM FOR TOURISM
mo_ta: The activity regulated by Article 55 of Law 36/2024/QH15 in which foreigners bring foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism.

id: foreign motor vehicles entering vietnam's road traffic
ten: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLES ENTERING VIETNAM'S ROAD TRAFFIC
mo_ta: The activity of organizing foreigners to bring foreign motor vehicles into road traffic in Vietnam, in this context for purposes other than tourism.

id: foreign motor vehicles participating in traffic in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLES PARTICIPATING IN TRAFFIC IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLES PARTICIPATING IN TRAFFIC IN VIETNAM refers to the use of foreign motor vehicles on Vietnamese roads by foreign nationals. The decree provides for organizing and guiding this activity, monitoring it, and sharing relevant information.
Foreign nationals who bring motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism and drive them in traffic there.

Foreign National Drivers are foreign nationals who drive foreign motor vehicles on roads in Vietnam. They must comply with Vietnamese road traffic laws and carry the required documents. When they participate in traffic in Vietnam, violations they commit may fall within the responsibilities assigned to the Ministry of Public Security.

Foreign nationals are people from outside Vietnam who may enter the country with foreign-registered motor vehicles for tourism or travel, including right-hand-drive vehicles, when the trip is arranged by a Vietnamese international travel service business and authorized under the applicable approval process. They may drive those vehicles in Vietnamese traffic only within the approved scope, routes, and travel periods, and must travel in a convoy where required.

Their entry, exit, transit, residence, and driving are subject to applicable documentation, visa, and entry requirements. A Vietnamese organization may need to invite and guarantee them, except where they are visa-exempt. Their permitted driving period is limited by the validity of their visa or visa-exemption period. If an unforeseen incident that cannot be resolved immediately prevents their departure, they may remain for up to 10 additional days under the stated conditions.

Foreign nationals must provide accurate and lawful information and documents and comply with Vietnamese law and the management requirements described in Article 36. Their activities, legal violations, and traffic accidents are subject to the specified management and reporting responsibilities. An approved trip may be suspended if they violate Vietnamese law and have not completed the competent authority’s requirements for resolving the violation. A route or schedule change, or an incident, may also affect or delay their departure.

id: foreign nationals driving foreign motor vehicles
ten: FOREIGN NATIONALS DRIVING FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLES
mo_ta: Foreign Nationals Driving Foreign Motor Vehicles are people from outside Vietnam who bring or operate foreign motor vehicles in Vietnam and participate in traffic there. Their activities, including the management of their vehicles and any legal violations, traffic accidents, or vehicle-related incidents, are addressed by Article 36 of Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP.

id: foreign nationals driving foreign motor vehicles in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN NATIONALS DRIVING FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLES IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: The activity addressed by Article 36: foreign nationals driving foreign motor vehicles in traffic in Vietnam.

id: foreign nationals operating foreign motor vehicles
ten: FOREIGN NATIONALS OPERATING FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLES
mo_ta: Foreign nationals who operate foreign motor vehicles while participating in traffic in Vietnam; they are the people whose management is addressed by Article 36.

id: foreign nationals’ traffic participation in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN NATIONALS’ TRAFFIC PARTICIPATION IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: The activity of foreign nationals operating foreign motor vehicles brought into Vietnam and participating in traffic there, which the named ministries are responsible for organizing and managing.

FOREIGN ORGANIZATIONS may be issued license plates for their vehicles featuring a white background, black characters and numbers, and the “NN” symbol, except for the subjects specified in point g. They may also arrange for right-hand-drive cars to participate in road traffic in Vietnam for purposes other than tourism, subject to the applicable approval procedure.

id: foreign personnel with diplomatic identity cards
ten: FOREIGN PERSONNEL WITH DIPLOMATIC IDENTITY CARDS
mo_ta: Foreign personnel carrying a diplomatic identity card issued by the relevant agency; their vehicles may receive license plates marked “NG,” with a white background, red lettering, and black numbers.
Foreign persons who may bring foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam to participate in traffic, subject to the stated approval condition.

FOREIGN REPRESENTATIVE AGENCIES IN VIETNAM are foreign agencies represented in Vietnam that coordinate with the relevant Vietnamese ministries to organize and manage activities involving foreign nationals and foreign motor vehicles brought into the country, including activities covered by Article 36.

id: foreign right-hand-drive vehicle road traffic in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN RIGHT-HAND-DRIVE VEHICLE ROAD TRAFFIC IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: The participation in Vietnamese road traffic of foreign-registered cars with right-hand-drive configurations, the circumstance addressed by Article 55.
A foreign person taking the examination who cannot read or write Vietnamese and uses an interpreter.
Test participants who are foreign nationals. When taking the test, they use an interpreter hired by the competent testing authority.

Foreign tourists are visitors from outside Vietnam who travel within the country. They may bring foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism when their travel is organized by a Vietnamese international travel service business. Road-travel programs and routes are to be developed for these visitors.

Foreign travelers are individuals from outside Vietnam who visit the country for tourism and may bring foreign motor vehicles under arrangements organized by Vietnamese international travel service businesses and covered by the relevant decree. Their information and planned departure timing may be subject to notification if they change.

The administrative procedure for approving arrangements involving foreigners bringing foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism, or organizations or individuals bringing right-hand-drive cars into Vietnamese traffic for non-tourism purposes.

FOREIGN VEHICLE DRIVERS are foreign nationals who drive foreign motor vehicles in road traffic in Vietnam under the conditions specified in the relevant provision. The provision requires information about these drivers to be recorded.

id: foreign vehicle entry and use approval process
ten: FOREIGN VEHICLE ENTRY AND USE APPROVAL PROCESS
mo_ta: The administrative process for a Vietnamese international travel business to arrange foreign visitors bringing foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism, or for an organization or individual to bring a right-hand-drive car into Vietnamese traffic for non-tourism purposes. The process may result in approval or refusal under the conditions described in Decree 151/2024/ND-CP.

id: foreign vehicle entry into vietnam for tourism
ten: FOREIGN VEHICLE ENTRY INTO VIETNAM FOR TOURISM
mo_ta: The entry into Vietnam of foreign motor vehicles for tourism, organized by a Vietnamese international travel service enterprise and subject to prior approval.
Registration of a smart transport vehicle in a foreign country, which is documented as part of the operating-permit application.

id: foreign vehicle road-traffic participation in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN VEHICLE ROAD-TRAFFIC PARTICIPATION IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: The participation of foreign motor vehicles and foreign drivers in road traffic in Vietnam, subject to the conditions stated in Article 32 of the decree.
An arrangement in which a Vietnamese international travel service enterprise organizes foreign visitors to bring foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism.

id: foreign vehicle tourism entry into vietnam
ten: FOREIGN VEHICLE TOURISM ENTRY INTO VIETNAM
mo_ta: The bringing of foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam by foreign visitors for tourism, the circumstance addressed by Article 55.

Foreign Vehicle Tourism in Vietnam is a tourism activity in which foreign visitors bring foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism. The activity is arranged by an approved Vietnamese international travel service enterprise, as described in Article 33.

id: foreign vehicle tourism trips in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN VEHICLE TOURISM TRIPS IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: Organized trips in which foreigners bring foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism, subject to the approval process described in the decree.

id: foreign vehicle traffic participation in vietnam
ten: FOREIGN VEHICLE TRAFFIC PARTICIPATION IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: The activity of foreign motor vehicles participating in traffic in Vietnam, as addressed by Article 32.

Foreign visitors are foreign nationals traveling to Vietnam for tourism who may bring foreign-registered motor vehicles into the country under the applicable regulatory procedure. Their trips must be organized through a Vietnamese international travel service enterprise and are subject to the required approval process. The regulations also address visitors’ departure timing and the permitted duration of their stay.
Foreign visitors who bring foreign motor vehicles into Vietnam for tourism through an approved travel-service arrangement.

A traffic violation committed by a person driving a road motor vehicle displaying a foreign license plate; Article 37 states that such violations are subject to a fine of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.
A violation in which the driver of a road motor vehicle bearing a foreign registration plate does not have the vehicle’s documents translated into English or Vietnamese as required

id: foreign-registered right-hand-drive cars participating in traffic
ten: FOREIGN-REGISTERED RIGHT-HAND-DRIVE CARS PARTICIPATING IN TRAFFIC
mo_ta: The road-traffic activity regulated by Article 55 of Law 36/2024/QH15, involving cars registered abroad with the steering wheel on the right and participating in traffic in Vietnam.
Procedures governed by Vietnamese law concerning the residence of foreigners in Vietnam.

FOREIGNERS are foreign nationals who bring and operate foreign motor vehicles on Vietnam’s roads for tourism under an approved arrangement, as described in Article 55 of Law 36/2024/QH15. A Vietnamese international travel-service business may organize their entry and travel. They must follow applicable entry and exit procedures, adhere to the registered program and itinerary, and declare temporary residence as required by law. The relevant decree addresses their departure timing and permitted period of stay; violations of Vietnamese law may result in suspension of the arrangement.

id: forfeiture of deposit and amounts paid
ten: FORFEITURE OF DEPOSIT AND AMOUNTS PAID
mo_ta: The loss of the winner’s deposit and any amount already paid when the winner fails to pay the full winning bid within the prescribed period.
The form specified for the license to use signal devices on priority vehicles.
The prescribed form, included in Appendix II to Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP, used for a new permit to use a signal device on a priority vehicle.
The types of administrative penalties addressed in Article 3 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.

The **FOUR-POINT DRIVER’S LICENSE DEDUCTION** is a penalty under Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. It deducts four points from a driver’s license for specified violations, including violations addressed under Articles 21 and 32. The deduction may be imposed in addition to other penalties; Article 32 applies where a vehicle owner directly operates the vehicle and commits a specified violation.
The deduction of four points from a driver's license imposed on a driver who commits a violation specified in Clause 2 or Clause 3 of Article 22.

A penalty under Article 6 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP that deducts four points from a driver’s license for violations specified in point h of clause 5, clause 6, point b of clause 7, and points b, c, and d of clause 9.

The **FOUR-POINT DRIVER’S-LICENSE DEDUCTION** is a sanction under which a driver loses four points from their license for committing a qualifying violation. The specified violations include those referenced in Clauses 4, 6, 7, and 8 of Article 7, as well as the violation identified in Point a of Clause 5 of Article 34.
The deduction of four points from a driver's license for conduct specified in Clause 5, as an additional consequence to the applicable penalty under Clause 7 of Article 23 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.
A four-point deduction from the driving license imposed in addition to other penalties for the specified over-capacity passenger violation.
Older people who are to be accommodated when participating in road traffic.

id: fraudulent obtaining of a driver's license
ten: FRAUDULENT OBTAINING OF A DRIVER'S LICENSE
mo_ta: Deceptive conduct by a license recipient to obtain, exchange, or have a driver's license reissued, which is grounds for revocation.
The transport of fresh food by road, which must comply with road traffic safety, food safety, epidemiological hygiene, disease-prevention, and environmental hygiene requirements.
The passage identifies vehicles carrying fresh food as a category in the priority order for crossing a ferry or pontoon bridge.

id: full deduction of driver’s license points
ten: FULL DEDUCTION OF DRIVER’S LICENSE POINTS
mo_ta: The event in which a driver’s license has had all of its points deducted, triggering the requirement for the holder to take and pass the road traffic law knowledge examination before points can be restored.
The condition in which all points on an automobile driving license have been deducted, making the holder eligible to restore points by passing both required legal-knowledge tests.

id: full deduction of remaining driver's license points
ten: FULL DEDUCTION OF REMAINING DRIVER'S LICENSE POINTS
mo_ta: The specific outcome required when the points remaining on a driver's license are fewer than the points otherwise to be deducted: all points still remaining are deducted.

Functional authorities are the relevant public authorities or enforcement personnel responsible for addressing road and traffic matters. Traffic police notify them of deficiencies in road and traffic organization and may recommend corrective measures. When a violation is discovered, functional authorities may also instruct how vehicles, machinery, equipment, signs, or advertisements must be removed.
Functional Forces are the competent forces that may be mobilized to perform duties and tasks when an emergency situation or state of emergency is declared.

The relevant functional unit responsible for handling hazardous chemicals and flammable or explosive materials. It must be notified immediately when a road traffic accident involves a vehicle carrying dangerous goods.
Units directed by the Ministry of Public Security to manage, install, and use signal-emitting devices on priority vehicles.

id: functional units of the ministry of national defense
ten: FUNCTIONAL UNITS OF THE MINISTRY OF NATIONAL DEFENSE
mo_ta: The Ministry of National Defense’s functional units, which it directs to manage, install, and use signal-emitting equipment on priority vehicles.

A **FUNERAL PROCESSION** is a category of priority-vehicle convoy. However, under the cited provision, funeral processions are expressly excluded from the vehicle groups eligible to have priority-vehicle signal devices installed.

A road traffic violation involving a gathering of three or more motorcycles or similar vehicles on a roadway or in a road tunnel. The text specifies a fine of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng for this conduct.

General Education Institutions are educational establishments—including preschool, primary, lower-secondary, and upper-secondary institutions—covered by the decree’s requirements concerning road-traffic legal education and compliance. They are settings where instruction on road traffic order and safety is organized, and where compliance with relevant laws is managed. Their teaching programs are to incorporate appropriate legal knowledge about road traffic order and safety, tailored to students’ educational levels. Their students are among the intended recipients of this education.
Students of general education institutions, identified as recipients of legal education on road traffic order and safety

The General Staff is one of the authorities empowered to issue, reissue, and revoke permits for the use of signal devices on priority vehicles belonging to military forces performing emergency missions.

id: giao phương tiện hoặc để cho người điều khiển vi phạm
ten: GIAO PHƯƠNG TIỆN HOẶC ĐỂ CHO NGƯỜI ĐIỀU KHIỂN VI PHẠM
mo_ta: Hành vi giao phương tiện cho người làm công hoặc để người điều khiển phương tiện thực hiện hành vi vi phạm quy định tại khoản 8a Điều 20 Nghị định 168/2024/NĐ-CP.

id: gift of a vehicle with an auction-winning plate
ten: GIFT OF A VEHICLE WITH AN AUCTION-WINNING PLATE
mo_ta: The gifting of a vehicle associated with a license plate won at auction; in this case, only the vehicle registration certificate is revoked.
A permitted action under Clause 1 of Article 38, allowing the auction winner to give away the vehicle associated with the winning license plate.

id: giám đốc công an cấp tỉnh
ten: GIÁM ĐỐC CÔNG AN CẤP TỈNH
mo_ta: The director of a provincial-level police force; the text states that this role may apply remedial measures specified in Clause 3, Article 3 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.

id: giám đốc công an tỉnh, thành phố
ten: GIÁM ĐỐC CÔNG AN TỈNH, THÀNH PHỐ
mo_ta: The directors of provincial and municipal police agencies, who are responsible for implementing the circular.

id: giám đốc khu quản lý đường bộ
ten: GIÁM ĐỐC KHU QUẢN LÝ ĐƯỜNG BỘ
mo_ta: The Director of a Regional Road Management Zone under the Vietnam Road Administration, identified in Article 44 among officials with sanctioning authority.
The Director of a Department of Construction, identified in Article 44 among officials with sanctioning authority.

id: giải quyết vụ việc vi phạm hành chính
ten: GIẢI QUYẾT VỤ VIỆC VI PHẠM HÀNH CHÍNH
mo_ta: The resolution of an administrative violation case in the field of road traffic order and safety, which the violator must complete as required by the competent authority.
A road median capable of preventing glare, which is stated as an exception to the restriction on using high-beam headlights when encountering oncoming traffic.

A violation involving placing goods in the passenger compartment of a passenger vehicle or a similar vehicle. The text states that this conduct is subject to a fine of 600,000 to 800,000 Vietnamese đồng.
The activity of loading or unloading goods, identified as a reason for temporarily stopping a vehicle.
A violation involving the receipt or delivery of goods, referenced in Article 20(8), Article 21(9), and Article 26(8)(c) of the decree.

GOODS TRANSPORT BY AUTOMOBILE is addressed by Article 49, which requires goods to be neatly arranged and securely fastened to ensure safety. When goods extend beyond the vehicle, drivers must also use warning signals.
The activity covered by Article 49, including transporting loose cargo, construction materials, or waste by car
The activity of transporting goods using motorcycles, motorized bicycles, or rudimentary vehicles, subject to requirements including carrying the legally prescribed documents.

id: goods transport within a smart border gate
ten: GOODS TRANSPORT WITHIN A SMART BORDER GATE
mo_ta: The transport of goods within the scope of a smart border gate by temporarily imported smart transport vehicles, subject to Government approval.

An act of violating road traffic order or safety requirements while driving a truck, tractor, or similar vehicle transporting goods, including one towing a trailer or semi-trailer. The provision identifies specified violations under Article 21 as triggering license-point deductions.
Violations of road traffic order and safety regulations by drivers of trucks, tractors, and similar vehicles transporting goods, including vehicles towing trailers or semi-trailers.

The Government of Vietnam is the national authority responsible for unified state management of road traffic order and safety. The Ministry of Public Security assists the Government as the focal agency, reports to it, and submits proposals. The Government’s subordinate agencies implement the relevant laws and decrees, and it may negotiate and sign international treaties and agreements concerning road traffic order and safety.

The Government is tasked with issuing detailed regulations across a wide range of related matters. These include the management, collection, use, connection, and sharing of information and data from vehicles, technical equipment, and road-traffic databases; the use of technical equipment to detect administrative violations; and product and goods recalls. It also regulates road-safety measures and the operation of inspection facilities.

In the licensing and operation of vehicles and drivers, the Government sets rules for vehicle license-plate auctions; the management and use of signaling devices on priority vehicles and the issuance, renewal, and revocation of permits for them; driver training and licensing; driver testing-center conditions and driving-test permits; motorcycle driving-test practice grounds; and the deduction and restoration of driving-licence points, including the implementation roadmap. It also specifies requirements for rudimentary vehicles and their operating conditions, and regulations on motor-vehicle service life.

The Government further provides detailed rules for road-traffic procedures and authorities, including those concerning the transport of goods within the scope of a smart border gate. These responsibilities are established or referenced under relevant provisions of Law 36/2024/QH15 and other applicable regulations.

Government agencies are subordinate to the Government and are responsible, within their assigned duties and authority, for implementing Decree 168/2024/ND-CP. Their heads are identified in the decree’s implementation provisions. These agencies must coordinate with the Ministry of Public Security to build and manage the database on road traffic order and safety. They may also own intelligent transport vehicles and prepare and submit the required application dossiers for operating permits.

id: government decree on vehicle inspection conditions
ten: GOVERNMENT DECREE ON VEHICLE INSPECTION CONDITIONS
mo_ta: An unspecified government decree referenced as setting conditions for vehicle inspection service businesses, the organization and operation of inspection establishments, and vehicle service life.

The Government of Vietnam is the national authority responsible for issuing the decrees and detailed regulations referenced in the source material, including Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP and Decrees 100/2019/NĐ-CP and 123/2021/NĐ-CP.

In road transport and traffic safety, the Government prescribes requirements and procedures for licensing, reissuing, and revoking driving-test-centre licenses; conditions for driving-test centres and motorcycle practice grounds; and rules for driver training, testing, assessment, instructor qualifications, permits, and certificates. It also provides detailed provisions for Articles 38, 55, and 77 of Law 36/2024/QH15, including rules for certain foreign-registered vehicles and foreign visitors travelling in Vietnam. Its responsibilities further include setting requirements for vehicle-inspection businesses and establishments, specifying the paint colour of vehicles transporting preschool children and students, regulating compulsory civil liability insurance for motor vehicle owners, and establishing rules for the Road Traffic Accident Damage Mitigation Fund. The Government also sets the implementation roadmap for installing image-recording equipment in the passenger compartments of specified passenger-transport vehicles.

The Government’s regulations govern funding for database activities, including rules for managing state-budget-funded information-technology investment, and the management, connection, and sharing of digital data among state agencies. It determines which international border gates electronic-visa holders may use to enter Vietnam.

Separately, the Prime Minister is assigned to prescribe the roadmap for applying motor-vehicle emission standards.

id: government regulations on compulsory civil liability insurance for motor vehicle owners
ten: GOVERNMENT REGULATIONS ON COMPULSORY CIVIL LIABILITY INSURANCE FOR MOTOR VEHICLE OWNERS
mo_ta: The government regulations governing compulsory civil liability insurance for motor vehicle owners, under which the relevant insurance database is maintained.
Rules issued by the government concerning management, connection, and sharing of digital data in state agencies.

id: granting a smart traffic vehicle operating permit
ten: GRANTING A SMART TRAFFIC VEHICLE OPERATING PERMIT
mo_ta: The administrative process for granting an operating permit for a smart traffic vehicle, addressed by Article 25a of the decree.

id: granting an intelligent transport vehicle operating permit
ten: GRANTING AN INTELLIGENT TRANSPORT VEHICLE OPERATING PERMIT
mo_ta: The act of granting an operating permit for an intelligent transport vehicle, as covered by the licensing procedures in Article 25a.
A road-traffic violation in which a person drives a group of two or more motorcycles, motorbikes, or similar vehicles faster than the prescribed speed limit.
A person who accompanies and guides someone who lacks civil act capacity when that person travels on a road.

id: guiding animals and driving animal-drawn vehicles
ten: GUIDING ANIMALS AND DRIVING ANIMAL-DRAWN VEHICLES
mo_ta: The road-use activity addressed by Article 32, subject to rules about keeping to the right side, crossing safely, and avoiding obstruction of other traffic.

id: handing over or allowing use of a vehicle
ten: HANDING OVER OR ALLOWING USE OF A VEHICLE
mo_ta: The act of a vehicle owner handing a vehicle to, or allowing an employee or representative to operate it, when that operation constitutes the violation described in point b, clause 4, Article 34 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.
The handling of violations of law, identified as a traffic-police task under Article 51.
Measures taken to address a legal violation identified during inspection and control.

id: handling of administrative violations concerning road traffic order and safety
ten: HANDLING OF ADMINISTRATIVE VIOLATIONS CONCERNING ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY
mo_ta: The administrative process whose information is recorded in the source database cited by the decree.
The process of addressing violations of road traffic order and safety laws and other legal violations.
The activity of addressing administrative violations concerning road traffic order and safety, as well as other violations of law, in accordance with applicable law.
The activity of addressing violations of laws concerning road traffic order and safety, according to procedures prescribed for the Traffic Police.

id: handling road traffic order and safety violations
ten: HANDLING ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY VIOLATIONS
mo_ta: Addressing violations of laws concerning road traffic order and safety.
The process of addressing violations of road traffic order and safety regulations involving vehicles transporting oversized or overweight cargo.

id: hanging onto or clinging to a vehicle
ten: HANGING ONTO OR CLINGING TO A VEHICLE
mo_ta: A passenger violation involving hanging onto or clinging to the side of a vehicle.

The operation of flying objects, unmanned aircraft, or ultralight aircraft within road boundaries in a way that obstructs or risks the safety of people or vehicles using the road. The text exempts unmanned aircraft and ultralight aircraft that have been granted flight permission.
The transport of dangerous goods by road, which is subject to requirements for road traffic order and safety.
Training in the transport of dangerous goods, required for drivers and escorts involved in transporting such goods.

An administrative violation in which a person transporting hazardous goods in an automobile fails to clean the vehicle or remove its hazardous-goods warning symbol after ceasing to transport those goods. Under Article 23 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the violation is punishable by a fine of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: head of a company-level mobile police unit
ten: HEAD OF A COMPANY-LEVEL MOBILE POLICE UNIT
mo_ta: The **Head of a Company-Level Mobile Police Unit** is a role, not a specifically named individual. Under the cited provision, the role holder is authorized to apply specified remedial measures and to confiscate exhibits and vehicles involved in administrative violations when their value does not exceed 30,000,000 đồng.

id: head of a professional division of the department of administrative management of social order
ten: HEAD OF A PROFESSIONAL DIVISION OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT OF SOCIAL ORDER
mo_ta: The official heading a professional division of the Department of Administrative Management of Social Order, listed in Article 43 as having sanctioning authority.

id: head of a professional division of the department of administrative police for social order
ten: HEAD OF A PROFESSIONAL DIVISION OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE POLICE FOR SOCIAL ORDER
mo_ta: An official heading a professional division within the Department of Administrative Police for Social Order, listed as an authority empowered to impose administrative penalties.

id: head of a professional division of the department of police for administrative management of social order
ten: HEAD OF A PROFESSIONAL DIVISION OF THE DEPARTMENT OF POLICE FOR ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT OF SOCIAL ORDER
mo_ta: An officeholder leading a professional division within the Department of Police for Administrative Management of Social Order, granted authority to impose penalties under Article 43.

id: head of a professional division of the traffic police department
ten: HEAD OF A PROFESSIONAL DIVISION OF THE TRAFFIC POLICE DEPARTMENT
mo_ta: The Head of a Professional Division of the Traffic Police Department is an official who leads a professional division within the department. Under Article 43, the officeholder is authorized to impose administrative penalties.

id: head of a provincial administrative police division
ten: HEAD OF A PROVINCIAL ADMINISTRATIVE POLICE DIVISION
mo_ta: An official heading a provincial division responsible for administrative police and social order; this is one of the specified provincial police division-head roles.

id: head of a provincial police division
ten: HEAD OF A PROVINCIAL POLICE DIVISION
mo_ta: An official heading a division of provincial-level police, listed as an authority empowered to impose administrative penalties.

id: head of a provincial traffic police division
ten: HEAD OF A PROVINCIAL TRAFFIC POLICE DIVISION
mo_ta: An official heading a provincial traffic police division; this is one of the specified provincial police division-head roles.

id: head of a provincial-level police division
ten: HEAD OF A PROVINCIAL-LEVEL POLICE DIVISION
mo_ta: The **Head of a Provincial-Level Police Division** is an official who leads a division within a provincial-level police force. The role includes heads of the provincial divisions responsible for administrative management of social order, traffic policing, and mobile policing. The officeholder is authorized to impose penalties under Article 43.

id: head of a traffic police department professional division
ten: HEAD OF A TRAFFIC POLICE DEPARTMENT PROFESSIONAL DIVISION
mo_ta: An official heading a professional division under the Traffic Police Department, listed in Article 43(4) as having authority to impose administrative sanctions.

id: head of an administrative management of social order police department professional division
ten: HEAD OF AN ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT OF SOCIAL ORDER POLICE DEPARTMENT PROFESSIONAL DIVISION
mo_ta: An official heading a professional division under the Department of Administrative Management of Social Order Police, listed in Article 43(4) as having authority to impose administrative sanctions.

id: head of border-gate or export-processing-zone police station
ten: HEAD OF BORDER-GATE OR EXPORT-PROCESSING-ZONE POLICE STATION
mo_ta: The **HEAD OF BORDER-GATE OR EXPORT-PROCESSING-ZONE POLICE STATION** is the official who heads a police station at a border gate or within an export-processing zone. Under the decree, the official may impose administrative penalties for specified road-traffic violations, but only within the scope of their assigned functions and duties.

The **Head of Commune-Level Police** is the official who leads a commune-level police force. Under the decree, the head may impose administrative penalties for specified road-traffic violations within the scope of their assigned functions and duties.
The official heading a district-level police unit, listed as an authority empowered to impose administrative penalties.

id: head of division of guidance, propaganda, investigation, and traffic accident resolution
ten: HEAD OF DIVISION OF GUIDANCE, PROPAGANDA, INVESTIGATION, AND TRAFFIC ACCIDENT RESOLUTION
mo_ta: An official heading the corresponding professional division within the Traffic Police Department; the position is included among those with authority to impose the specified penalties.

id: head of division of guidance, training, testing, and driver license management
ten: HEAD OF DIVISION OF GUIDANCE, TRAINING, TESTING, AND DRIVER LICENSE MANAGEMENT
mo_ta: An official heading the division responsible for training, testing, and driver license management guidance; the position is included among those with authority to impose the specified penalties.

id: head of division of guidance, vehicle registration, and inspection
ten: HEAD OF DIVISION OF GUIDANCE, VEHICLE REGISTRATION, AND INSPECTION
mo_ta: An official heading the division responsible for vehicle registration and inspection guidance; the position is included among those with authority to impose the specified penalties.

id: head of inspection delegation established by the director of the vietnam road administration
ten: HEAD OF INSPECTION DELEGATION ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: The Head of the Inspection Delegation established by the Director of the Vietnam Road Administration is listed in Article 44 among officials authorized to impose administrative penalties.

id: head of inspection delegation established by the minister of construction
ten: HEAD OF INSPECTION DELEGATION ESTABLISHED BY THE MINISTER OF CONSTRUCTION
mo_ta: The Head of the Inspection Delegation established by the Minister of Construction is listed in Article 44 among officials authorized to impose administrative penalties.

id: head of inspection team established by the director of the vietnam road administration
ten: HEAD OF INSPECTION TEAM ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: The head of an inspection team established by the Director of the Vietnam Road Administration is identified in Article 44 as an official authorized to impose administrative penalties.

id: head of inspection team established by the minister of construction
ten: HEAD OF INSPECTION TEAM ESTABLISHED BY THE MINISTER OF CONSTRUCTION
mo_ta: The **Head of the Inspection Team Established by the Minister of Construction** is authorized under Article 44, clause 3, to impose administrative penalties.

The HEAD OF POLICE POST is the official responsible for heading a police post. Under the decree, the official may impose administrative penalties for specified road-traffic violations, within the scope of their assigned functions and duties.

id: head of regiment-level mobile police unit
ten: HEAD OF REGIMENT-LEVEL MOBILE POLICE UNIT
mo_ta: The unnamed head of a regiment-level Mobile Police unit, whose position grants authority to impose penalties under Article 43.

id: head of the division of guidance on propaganda, investigation, and traffic accident resolution
ten: HEAD OF THE DIVISION OF GUIDANCE ON PROPAGANDA, INVESTIGATION, AND TRAFFIC ACCIDENT RESOLUTION
mo_ta: The title of the person heading the Traffic Police Department division responsible for guidance on propaganda, investigation, and traffic accident resolution; the text identifies this division head as having administrative penalty authority.

id: head of the division of guidance, propaganda, investigation and traffic accident resolution
ten: HEAD OF THE DIVISION OF GUIDANCE, PROPAGANDA, INVESTIGATION AND TRAFFIC ACCIDENT RESOLUTION
mo_ta: The unnamed division chief identified in the decree as having sanctioning authority.

id: head of the division of guidance, training, testing and driver's licence management
ten: HEAD OF THE DIVISION OF GUIDANCE, TRAINING, TESTING AND DRIVER'S LICENCE MANAGEMENT
mo_ta: The unnamed division chief identified in the decree as having sanctioning authority.

id: head of the division of guidance, training, testing, and driver-licence management
ten: HEAD OF THE DIVISION OF GUIDANCE, TRAINING, TESTING, AND DRIVER-LICENCE MANAGEMENT
mo_ta: The title of the person heading the Traffic Police Department division responsible for guidance, training, testing, and management of driver licences; the text identifies this division head as having administrative penalty authority.

id: head of the division of guidance, vehicle registration and inspection
ten: HEAD OF THE DIVISION OF GUIDANCE, VEHICLE REGISTRATION AND INSPECTION
mo_ta: The unnamed division chief identified in the decree as having sanctioning authority.

id: head of the division of guidance, vehicle registration, and inspection
ten: HEAD OF THE DIVISION OF GUIDANCE, VEHICLE REGISTRATION, AND INSPECTION
mo_ta: The title of the person heading the Traffic Police Department division responsible for guidance, vehicle registration, and inspection; the text identifies this division head as having administrative penalty authority.

id: head of the division of police for administrative management of social order
ten: HEAD OF THE DIVISION OF POLICE FOR ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT OF SOCIAL ORDER
mo_ta: The head of the provincial-level division responsible for police administrative management of social order, authorized under Article 43 to impose penalties.

id: head of the inspection delegation established by the director general of the vietnam road administration
ten: HEAD OF THE INSPECTION DELEGATION ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR GENERAL OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: The leader of an inspection delegation established by the Director General of the Vietnam Road Administration, identified in Article 44 as having penalty-imposing authority.

id: head of the inspection delegation established by the director of the vietnam road administration
ten: HEAD OF THE INSPECTION DELEGATION ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: The Head of the Inspection Delegation established by the Director of the Vietnam Road Administration is listed in Article 44 as an official with administrative sanctioning authority. The office may impose fines of up to 60,000,000 đồng and apply other administrative measures specified in that Article.

id: head of the inspection delegation established by the minister of construction
ten: HEAD OF THE INSPECTION DELEGATION ESTABLISHED BY THE MINISTER OF CONSTRUCTION
mo_ta: The **Head of the Inspection Delegation Established by the Minister of Construction** is granted sanctioning authority under Article 44. This authority includes imposing fines of up to 75,000,000 đồng and applying the specified remedial measures and other administrative measures, including those provided for in Clause 3.

id: head of the inspection team established by the director general of the vietnam road administration
ten: HEAD OF THE INSPECTION TEAM ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR GENERAL OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: The head of the inspection team established by the Director General of the Vietnam Road Administration is authorized to impose administrative penalties under Article 41. Article 44 also identifies this position as having sanctioning authority.

id: head of the inspection team established by the director of the vietnam road administration
ten: HEAD OF THE INSPECTION TEAM ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: The head of an inspection team established by the Director of the Vietnam Road Administration is an unnamed official with sanctioning authority under Article 44. The role is authorized to impose fines of up to 60,000,000 đồng and to apply the remedial measures specified in Article 44(2).

id: head of the inspection team established by the minister of construction
ten: HEAD OF THE INSPECTION TEAM ESTABLISHED BY THE MINISTER OF CONSTRUCTION
mo_ta: The Head of the Inspection Team established by the Minister of Construction is an unnamed official with authority to impose administrative penalties under Article 41. Article 44 lists this position among the officials with sanctioning authority.

id: head of the ministry-established inspection team
ten: HEAD OF THE MINISTRY-ESTABLISHED INSPECTION TEAM
mo_ta: The head of an inspection team established by the Minister of Construction, authorized to impose specified administrative penalties.

id: head of the mobile police division
ten: HEAD OF THE MOBILE POLICE DIVISION
mo_ta: The head of the provincial-level Mobile Police Division, authorized under Article 43 to impose penalties.

id: head of the provincial administrative management of social order division
ten: HEAD OF THE PROVINCIAL ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT OF SOCIAL ORDER DIVISION
mo_ta: The official heading the provincial-level police division responsible for administrative management of social order, listed as having sanctioning authority.

id: head of the provincial traffic police division
ten: HEAD OF THE PROVINCIAL TRAFFIC POLICE DIVISION
mo_ta: The **Head of the Provincial Traffic Police Division** is the official who leads the province-level traffic police division and is listed as having sanctioning authority. When the provincial-level People’s Committee chairperson issues an administrative penalty decision, the Head is responsible for entering the related driving-licence point-deduction data into the relevant database.

id: head of the traffic police division
ten: HEAD OF THE TRAFFIC POLICE DIVISION
mo_ta: The **HEAD OF THE TRAFFIC POLICE DIVISION** is the official who leads the provincial-level Traffic Police Division and oversees the organization of road-traffic legal-knowledge tests. The official is authorized under Article 43 to impose penalties and, in cases covered by Clause 3 of Article 51, to restore driving-licence points.

id: head of the vietnam road administration-established inspection team
ten: HEAD OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION-ESTABLISHED INSPECTION TEAM
