mo_ta: The head of an inspection team established by the Director General of the Vietnam Road Administration, authorized to impose specified administrative penalties.

id: heads of administrative police professional departments
ten: HEADS OF ADMINISTRATIVE POLICE PROFESSIONAL DEPARTMENTS
mo_ta: The unnamed heads of the Administrative Police Department for Social Order’s professional departments, whose positions grant them authority to impose penalties under Article 43.

id: heads of agencies under the government
ten: HEADS OF AGENCIES UNDER THE GOVERNMENT
mo_ta: The officials leading agencies under the Government, identified as responsible for implementing Decree 151/2024/ND-CP
The heads of government agencies, including agencies attached to the Government, are responsible for implementing Decree 168/2024/ND-CP.

The heads of ministerial-level agencies, including agencies equivalent to ministries, are the officials responsible for implementing Decree 238/2026/ND-CP, Decree 168/2024/ND-CP, and Decree 151/2024/ND-CP.
The unnamed heads of the provincial administrative, traffic, and mobile police divisions, whose positions grant authority to impose penalties under Article 43.

id: heads of traffic police professional departments
ten: HEADS OF TRAFFIC POLICE PROFESSIONAL DEPARTMENTS
mo_ta: The unnamed heads of the Traffic Police Department’s professional departments, whose positions grant them authority to impose penalties under Article 43.
Heads of units under ministry agencies, who are responsible for implementing Circular 13/2025/TT-BCA.

id: heads of units under the ministry’s agencies
ten: HEADS OF UNITS UNDER THE MINISTRY’S AGENCIES
mo_ta: Officials who lead units within agencies of the Ministry of Public Security and are responsible for implementing the circular.
The assessment of whether a driving-licence holder meets the health requirements for the relevant licence class, based on a conclusion from a medical examination and treatment facility.

Healthcare and medical treatment facilities that provide initial emergency care to people injured in road traffic accidents. They must promptly notify the nearest police authority, arrange required blood tests for the driver, and, if unable to conduct testing, preserve and send the blood sample to a testing facility.

An **HEIR** is a person entitled under inheritance law to receive the full amount paid by the winning bidder at an auction if the bidder dies within the specified period and before registering a vehicle to which the auctioned plate is to be attached.
The requirement that motorcycle and motorbike drivers and passengers wear helmets compliant with national technical standards and fasten them correctly.
Agencies responsible for managing high schools; they coordinate with the Traffic Police Force to organize safe motorbike-riding instruction for students.

The authorities responsible for managing high schools, directed to prepare facilities and motorbikes and coordinate with the Traffic Police Force to organize safe motorbike-driving skills instruction.
Students at the upper-secondary level who are included among the recipients of education on the laws concerning road traffic order and safety.

High schools are educational institutions covered by Decree 151/2024/ND-CP. They are responsible for educating students about road-traffic order and safety laws and for including compliance with those laws among the criteria for evaluating and classifying student conduct. Under Article 6, they also guide students in safe motorbike-riding skills, organize students and their families to sign commitments to follow road-traffic laws and safety requirements, and work with student parent representative boards to support compliance. High schools must remind students to honor their commitments and communicate with families about students’ compliance.

id: high-beam headlight use in restricted situations
ten: HIGH-BEAM HEADLIGHT USE IN RESTRICTED SITUATIONS
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation described in Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, Article 8, Clause 3: using high-beam headlights when encountering pedestrians crossing, on a residential road with operating lighting, when encountering oncoming traffic except where a glare-preventing median is present, or when turning at an intersection.
A road where the cited rules govern stopping, parking, and emergency vehicle stops.
The authority responsible for managing the expressway; drivers are instructed to notify it when their vehicle cannot be moved into the emergency stopping lane.

Traffic violations covered by the decree include stopping or parking improperly on a highway, failing to use hazard warning lights when forced to stop on an emergency stopping lane or strip, and failing to provide required warning signals or a warning sign when stopped on a traffic lane. The stated fine is 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: highway traffic stopping and warning-signal violations
ten: HIGHWAY TRAFFIC STOPPING AND WARNING-SIGNAL VIOLATIONS
mo_ta: The violations described include stopping or parking in an unauthorized place on a highway, and stopping or parking on a highway due to a technical failure or other force majeure without the required emergency lights and, in some circumstances, a warning sign or warning light placed at least 150 meters behind the vehicle.
The crest of a hill, identified as a location with restricted visibility where overtaking is prohibited on a two-way road.
An individual who may be hired by an authorized detention official to move a violating vehicle when the official cannot arrange the relocation directly.
An organization that may be hired by an authorized detention official to move a violating vehicle when the official cannot arrange the relocation directly.

id: hiring a third party to move a vehicle
ten: HIRING A THIRD PARTY TO MOVE A VEHICLE
mo_ta: The arrangement by an authorized detention official to hire an organization or individual to relocate a violating vehicle when the official cannot carry out the move.
Hospital areas, listed as places where road users must observe, slow down, or stop to ensure safety
Police operations to rescue hostages.

id: hoạt động tuần tra, kiểm soát về trật tự, an toàn giao thông đường bộ
ten: HOẠT ĐỘNG TUẦN TRA, KIỂM SOÁT VỀ TRẬT TỰ, AN TOÀN GIAO THÔNG ĐƯỜNG BỘ
mo_ta: The activity of patrolling and controlling matters concerning road traffic order and safety, as described in Article 65 of Law 36/2024/QH15.

id: học sinh trung học cơ sở
ten: HỌC SINH TRUNG HỌC CƠ SỞ
mo_ta: Lower secondary school students for whom the decree specifies education on road traffic laws and the safe operation of bicycles and electric bicycles

id: identification of causes of traffic disorder and unsafety
ten: IDENTIFICATION OF CAUSES OF TRAFFIC DISORDER AND UNSAFETY
mo_ta: An activity in which traffic police identify causes that lead to disorder or unsafe conditions in road traffic.

id: identification of road and traffic organization deficiencies
ten: IDENTIFICATION OF ROAD AND TRAFFIC ORGANIZATION DEFICIENCIES
mo_ta: An activity in which traffic police identify shortcomings in roads and in the organization of road traffic.

id: illegal alteration of chassis or engine numbers
ten: ILLEGAL ALTERATION OF CHASSIS OR ENGINE NUMBERS
mo_ta: The prohibited act of cutting, welding, erasing, chiseling, modifying, or illegally re-stamping a vehicle’s chassis number or engine number.

id: illegal assembly of road motor vehicles
ten: ILLEGAL ASSEMBLY OF ROAD MOTOR VEHICLES
mo_ta: The unlawful assembly of motor vehicles for road use, identified in Article 31 as conduct subject to penalties.
The unlawful racing of bicycles on public roads, identified as a violation subject to vehicle confiscation under the cited provision.
The unlawful racing of cars or motorcycles on public traffic roads, addressed as a violation under the cited regulation

id: illegal chiseling or alteration of vehicle identification numbers
ten: ILLEGAL CHISELING OR ALTERATION OF VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBERS
mo_ta: The prohibited act of chiseling or otherwise altering the chassis or engine number of a motor vehicle or specialized motorcycle.

id: illegal cutting of vehicle identification numbers
ten: ILLEGAL CUTTING OF VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBERS
mo_ta: The prohibited act of cutting the chassis or engine number of a motor vehicle or specialized motorcycle.

id: illegal dumping in the road land area
ten: ILLEGAL DUMPING IN THE ROAD LAND AREA
mo_ta: The act of illegally dumping garbage, soil, sand, rocks, materials, or waste within land designated for roads.
The traffic violation of illegally dumping garbage, soil, sand, stones, materials, or waste onto streets, punishable under Article 17 by a fine of 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 đồng.

id: illegal erasure of vehicle identification numbers
ten: ILLEGAL ERASURE OF VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBERS
mo_ta: The prohibited act of erasing the chassis or engine number of a motor vehicle or specialized motorcycle.

An act of gathering a large number of people on a road without authorization, identified as a violation subject to a fine of 200,000 to 250,000 Vietnamese dong under Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, Article 12, Clause 2.

id: illegal installation or use of a priority signaling device
ten: ILLEGAL INSTALLATION OR USE OF A PRIORITY SIGNALING DEVICE
mo_ta: The conduct described in point đ, clause 2 of Article 7, involving installation or use of a priority-signaling device contrary to regulations.

A road traffic violation involving changing lanes where permitted rules are not followed: changing lanes in a prohibited place, failing to signal in advance, or moving across more than one adjacent lane at a time. The text states that this violation is punishable by a fine of 200,000 to 400,000 Vietnamese dong under Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, Article 7.
The violation of driving a vehicle with a license plate that does not match its registration certificate or was not issued by a competent authority; the provision also covers a towed trailer.

id: illegal manufacture and assembly of road motor vehicles
ten: ILLEGAL MANUFACTURE AND ASSEMBLY OF ROAD MOTOR VEHICLES
mo_ta: Conduct prohibited under Article 31 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP and subject to administrative penalties; individuals or organizations committing it may also be required to return unlawful gains.

id: illegal manufacture of road motor vehicles
ten: ILLEGAL MANUFACTURE OF ROAD MOTOR VEHICLES
mo_ta: The unlawful manufacture of motor vehicles for road use, identified in Article 31 as conduct subject to penalties.

id: illegal manufacture of vehicle license plates
ten: ILLEGAL MANUFACTURE OF VEHICLE LICENSE PLATES
mo_ta: The unlawful production of vehicle license plates, which Article 31 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP penalizes with fines of 40,000,000–50,000,000 đồng for individuals and 80,000,000–100,000,000 đồng for organizations.

id: illegal manufacture or assembly of road motor vehicles
ten: ILLEGAL MANUFACTURE OR ASSEMBLY OF ROAD MOTOR VEHICLES
mo_ta: **ILLEGAL MANUFACTURE OR ASSEMBLY OF ROAD MOTOR VEHICLES** refers to the unauthorized or otherwise unlawful production or assembly of motor vehicles intended for road use. Article 31 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP identifies this conduct as subject to penalties: individuals may be fined **40,000,000–50,000,000 đồng**, while organizations may be fined **80,000,000–100,000,000 đồng**.

id: illegal manufacture or assembly of road motor vehicles and illegal manufacture, purchase, or sale of vehicle license plates
ten: ILLEGAL MANUFACTURE OR ASSEMBLY OF ROAD MOTOR VEHICLES AND ILLEGAL MANUFACTURE, PURCHASE, OR SALE OF VEHICLE LICENSE PLATES
mo_ta: Conduct addressed by Article 31 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. The text specifies fines for individuals and organizations that illegally manufacture license plates or illegally manufacture or assemble road motor vehicles; its heading also refers to the illegal purchase and sale of license plates.

Illegal motor racing is the prohibited activity addressed by Article 35 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. The provision also covers organizing, inciting, or cheering illegal races and states that vehicles may be confiscated from drivers who commit specified violations.

id: illegal motor vehicle production and assembly
ten: ILLEGAL MOTOR VEHICLE PRODUCTION AND ASSEMBLY
mo_ta: The illegal production or assembly of road motor vehicles, an activity identified in the heading of Article 31.
The unlawful racing of motorcycles on public roads, identified as a violation subject to vehicle confiscation under the cited provision.
The unlawful racing of motorized bicycles on public roads, identified as a violation subject to vehicle confiscation under the cited provision.
The act of parking or leaving a vehicle on a sidewalk unlawfully, identified in the text as a violation subject to a fine of 600,000 to 800,000 Vietnamese đồng.
A road traffic violation consisting of illegally placing or leaving obstacles or other obstructions on a roadway.

id: illegal production of vehicle license plates
ten: ILLEGAL PRODUCTION OF VEHICLE LICENSE PLATES
mo_ta: The unlawful production of vehicle license plates, identified in Article 31 as conduct subject to penalties.

id: illegal production, purchase, or sale of vehicle license plates
ten: ILLEGAL PRODUCTION, PURCHASE, OR SALE OF VEHICLE LICENSE PLATES
mo_ta: ILLEGAL PRODUCTION, PURCHASE, OR SALE OF VEHICLE LICENSE PLATES refers to the unlawful manufacture, purchase, or sale of vehicle license plates. Article 31 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP identifies these activities as prohibited conduct subject to penalties.

id: illegal purchase of vehicle license plates
ten: ILLEGAL PURCHASE OF VEHICLE LICENSE PLATES
mo_ta: The unlawful purchase of vehicle license plates, identified in Article 31 as conduct subject to penalties.

id: illegal purchase or sale of vehicle license plates
ten: ILLEGAL PURCHASE OR SALE OF VEHICLE LICENSE PLATES
mo_ta: The illegal purchase or sale of vehicle license plates, conduct named in the heading of Article 31 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.
People who cheer or support illegal racing, included among the conduct addressed by the regulation
People who incite or encourage illegal racing, included among the conduct addressed by the regulation
People who organize illegal races, included among the conduct addressed by the regulation
People who participate in illegal vehicle racing, whose conduct is subject to penalties under Article 35.
Illegal racing is a prohibited activity addressed in Article 35. The article provides for fines for organizing illegal races and also covers participating in, inciting, or cheering on such races.
People who drive vehicles while participating in illegal racing; the text states that their vehicles may be confiscated

id: illegal restamping of vehicle identification numbers
ten: ILLEGAL RESTAMPING OF VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBERS
mo_ta: The prohibited act of illegally restamping the chassis or engine number of a motor vehicle or specialized motorcycle.
Illegal racing is identified as a prohibited activity under Article 9 of Law 36/2024/QH15.

id: illegal road racing and related dangerous driving
ten: ILLEGAL ROAD RACING AND RELATED DANGEROUS DRIVING
mo_ta: A traffic-violation activity addressed by Article 35 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. It includes illegal racing, gathering to cheer or assist it, inciting it, and driving over the speed limit, swerving, weaving, or chasing one another on the road. The article provides for fines of 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 Vietnamese dong for the specified conduct.
The violation of stopping or parking a vehicle on a road, described as a circumstance that may cause obstruction, congestion, or a risk of a road traffic accident.

A road traffic violation involving illegally parking or leaving a motorcycle or similar vehicle on a roadway or sidewalk. The text specifies a fine of 400,000 to 600,000 Vietnamese đồng for this conduct.

id: illegal sale of vehicle license plates
ten: ILLEGAL SALE OF VEHICLE LICENSE PLATES
mo_ta: The unlawful sale of vehicle license plates, identified in Article 31 as conduct subject to penalties.

**ILLEGAL STOPPING OR PARKING** is a road traffic violation addressed by Article 69 of the decree. It occurs when a vehicle is stopped or parked contrary to applicable rules, including on a roadway or in an area reserved for another use. Prohibited locations include the left side of a one-way road, a blind curve or hill crest, a bridge, an unauthorized area beneath an overpass, or alongside another stopped or parked vehicle. Such stopping or parking may obstruct traffic, cause congestion, or create a risk of an accident.

id: illegal stopping or parking obstructing traffic
ten: ILLEGAL STOPPING OR PARKING OBSTRUCTING TRAFFIC
mo_ta: A road traffic violation in which a vehicle is stopped or parked in a way that obstructs or congests traffic, or creates a risk of a road traffic accident.

id: illegal stopping, parking, or making a u-turn
ten: ILLEGAL STOPPING, PARKING, OR MAKING A U-TURN
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation in which a driver stops, parks, or makes a U-turn contrary to regulations.

id: illegal transport of a container with its roof cut off
ten: ILLEGAL TRANSPORT OF A CONTAINER WITH ITS ROOF CUT OFF
mo_ta: A violation involving carrying a container on a vehicle, including a semi-trailer, after its roof has been cut off contrary to regulations; the cited provision sets a fine of 8,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese đồng

id: illegal use of the central median strip
ten: ILLEGAL USE OF THE CENTRAL MEDIAN STRIP
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation described in the text: occupying the central median strip of a divided road to display or sell goods, store construction materials, or park, watch, or keep vehicles.

id: illegal vehicle license plate production, purchase, or sale
ten: ILLEGAL VEHICLE LICENSE PLATE PRODUCTION, PURCHASE, OR SALE
mo_ta: The unauthorized production, purchase, or sale of vehicle license plates, prohibited under Article 31 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP and subject to administrative penalties and the return of unlawful gains.
The prohibited act of illegally modifying a vehicle.

Illegal vehicle racing is the prohibited activity addressed in Article 35 of Decree 168/2024/ND-CP. The article covers penalties and driving-licence point deductions for people who race illegally, organize illegal races, or incite or cheer on illegal racing.
The unauthorized purchase or sale of vehicle registration plates that were not produced by, or permitted by, a competent state authority.

id: illegal welding of vehicle identification numbers
ten: ILLEGAL WELDING OF VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBERS
mo_ta: The prohibited act of welding the chassis or engine number of a motor vehicle or specialized motorcycle.
People who operate vehicles while engaging in the illegal-racing conduct described in Article 35, including the conduct referenced in point b, clause 3.

id: illegible or altered license plate characters
ten: ILLEGIBLE OR ALTERED LICENSE PLATE CHARACTERS
mo_ta: A violation involving license plates with unclear letters or numbers, or characters or numbers covered with materials other than paint.
The immediate warning action required when an unexpected situation may endanger people or vehicles participating in road traffic.
The authority responsible for managing immigration matters in Vietnam, which must be notified by the licensing authority in the circumstances specified in Article 55.
A road traffic violation involving passing another vehicle on its right when that maneuver is not permitted.
The administrative activity of carrying out Circular 13/2025/TT-BCA, which the department director is responsible for overseeing.

The carrying out of the circular’s provisions, for which designated officials, organizations, and individuals are responsible; difficulties encountered during implementation may be reported for guidance.
The activity of organizing and carrying out the decree, assigned to the ministries, central agencies, and provincial-level bodies named in the text

The action taken by persons performing official duties when road traffic participants fail to comply with inspection or control requests or obstruct or resist them; the specific measures are not stated in the excerpt.
Border gates through which vehicles are imported or exported; no specific gates are named.

IMPORT ESTABLISHMENTS are establishments that import motor vehicles, specialized motorcycles, or related items. They are among the organizations covered by Clause 2 of Article 2 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP and are subject to the stated fine for the specified violation.
Facilities that import motor vehicles, special-use motorcycles, or motor vehicle parts and are among the entities subject to the stated fine if they commit the specified violation.
A location where vehicles are imported and from which they may be transported to their place of use.
Import of motor vehicles, specialized motor vehicles, and motor vehicle parts, for which technical safety and environmental protection assurance is addressed.

id: importation of covered vehicles and parts
ten: IMPORTATION OF COVERED VEHICLES AND PARTS
mo_ta: The importation of motor vehicles, specialized motorcycles, and motor vehicle parts, which is subject to the requirements addressed in Article 41

id: importation of motor vehicles and motor vehicle parts
ten: IMPORTATION OF MOTOR VEHICLES AND MOTOR VEHICLE PARTS
mo_ta: The import activity covered by Article 41 in relation to the technical safety quality and environmental protection requirements for motor vehicles, specialized motorcycles, and motor vehicle parts.

id: importing and exporting organizations and enterprises
ten: IMPORTING AND EXPORTING ORGANIZATIONS AND ENTERPRISES
mo_ta: Organizations and businesses involved in importing or exporting vehicles; the text does not name specific entities.
The prohibited act of importing motor vehicles that fail to comply with legal requirements for technical safety quality and environmental protection.
The prohibited act of importing specialized motor vehicles, including specialized motorcycles, that fail to comply with legal requirements for technical safety quality and environmental protection.

id: imposing a fine of 8,000,000 to 10,000,000 vietnamese dong
ten: IMPOSING A FINE OF 8,000,000 TO 10,000,000 VIETNAMESE DONG
mo_ta: The monetary penalty prescribed in Clause 3 for the specified violation, subject to the stated exception for a valid circulation permit.

id: imposing fines and deducting driving-license points
ten: IMPOSING FINES AND DEDUCTING DRIVING-LICENSE POINTS
mo_ta: A penalty action under Article 32, Clause 14, for vehicle owners who violate road traffic regulations. The clause provides fines of 28,000,000–30,000,000 VND for individuals and 56,000,000–60,000,000 VND for organizations.

id: imposing fines for the specified violations
ten: IMPOSING FINES FOR THE SPECIFIED VIOLATIONS
mo_ta: The penalty specified in Article 26, clause 8: fines of 10,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese dong for individuals and 20,000,000 to 24,000,000 Vietnamese dong for organizations operating transport or transport-support services.

id: imposing fines on individual vehicle owners
ten: IMPOSING FINES ON INDIVIDUAL VEHICLE OWNERS
mo_ta: The penalty applied to individual vehicle owners for the specified violation, ranging from 4,000,000 to 6,000,000 VND.

id: imposing fines on organizational vehicle owners
ten: IMPOSING FINES ON ORGANIZATIONAL VEHICLE OWNERS
mo_ta: The penalty applied to organizational vehicle owners for the specified violation, ranging from 8,000,000 to 12,000,000 VND.
The penalty specified in Article 39(2) of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for a driving training establishment that commits one of the listed violations
The penalty prescribed for the specified pedestrian traffic violations, including carrying bulky objects that obstruct traffic.
An administrative fine for the vehicle-owner violation is set at 8,000,000–10,000,000 Vietnamese dong for an individual owner and 16,000,000–20,000,000 Vietnamese dong for an organizational owner.

id: imposition of a fine for the horn violation
ten: IMPOSITION OF A FINE FOR THE HORN VIOLATION
mo_ta: A monetary penalty of 3,000,000 to 4,000,000 Vietnamese đồng prescribed for the specified violation of using a vehicle horn louder than permitted

id: imposition of a fine for the violation
ten: IMPOSITION OF A FINE FOR THE VIOLATION
mo_ta: The enforcement action specified in Decree 168/2024/ND-CP, Article 6: fining a driver from 800,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese dong for the described seat-belt-related traffic violation.

id: imposition of a fine of 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 vietnamese đồng
ten: IMPOSITION OF A FINE OF 10,000,000 TO 15,000,000 VIETNAMESE ĐỒNG
mo_ta: The penalty specified in Article 40, Clause 2, for an inspection facility that commits one of the listed violations.

id: imposition of a fine of 2,000,000 to 3,000,000 vnd
ten: IMPOSITION OF A FINE OF 2,000,000 TO 3,000,000 VND
mo_ta: The administrative fine specified in Article 13, khoản 4, for one of the listed violations, including driving a truck whose cargo-body dimensions do not match its inspection-certificate specifications.

id: imposition of a fine of 300,000 to 400,000 vietnamese đồng
ten: IMPOSITION OF A FINE OF 300,000 TO 400,000 VIETNAMESE ĐỒNG
mo_ta: The penalty specified in Article 15 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP for operating a vehicle without a required braking system or with an ineffective one.

id: imposition of a fine of 300,000 to 400,000 vnd
ten: IMPOSITION OF A FINE OF 300,000 TO 400,000 VND
mo_ta: The monetary penalty specified in Article 36, clause 1, for the listed goods-transport violations.

id: imposition of a fine up to 37,500,000 vietnamese dong
ten: IMPOSITION OF A FINE UP TO 37,500,000 VIETNAMESE DONG
mo_ta: The administrative penalty that a commune-level People’s Committee chairperson is authorized to impose under Clause 1.

The **IMPOSITION OF A MONETARY FINE** refers to administrative penalties that vary according to the violation. Under Article 13, Clause 7, the fine is 10,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for the listed violations. For the unlawful refusal of inspection services, the fine is 16,000,000 to 20,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.
The process of penalizing an administrative violation under the decree that was in force when the violation was committed.
The process of imposing penalties for administrative violations, whose authority is addressed by Article 45

The **Imposition of Administrative Sanctions** is the act of imposing penalties for administrative violations. Under Article 43, Clause 5, this sanctioning authority is exercised by the specified professional division heads.
The act of penalizing an administrative violation under the decree in force when the violation was discovered.

id: imposition of fines and driver’s-license point deductions
ten: IMPOSITION OF FINES AND DRIVER’S-LICENSE POINT DEDUCTIONS
mo_ta: The enforcement action described in Article 6 of the decree: imposing penalties and deducting points from the driver’s license for specified road traffic violations.

id: imposition of fines and driving-license point deductions
ten: IMPOSITION OF FINES AND DRIVING-LICENSE POINT DEDUCTIONS
mo_ta: The sanctioning action described in the heading of Article 21 for drivers of cargo-carrying vehicles that violate road traffic order and safety requirements.

id: imposition of fines for failure to update vehicle registration
ten: IMPOSITION OF FINES FOR FAILURE TO UPDATE VEHICLE REGISTRATION
mo_ta: The penalty specified in Clause 3 of Article 32: a fine of 800,000 to 1,000,000 VND for an individual vehicle owner, or 1,600,000 to 2,000,000 VND for an organizational vehicle owner, for failing to complete registration procedures after a change of ownership.

id: imposition of fines for vehicle overloading
ten: IMPOSITION OF FINES FOR VEHICLE OVERLOADING
mo_ta: The text specifies monetary penalties for individuals and organizations that load a motor vehicle beyond the permitted carrying capacity by more than 50% and up to 100%.
The application of penalties to individuals or organizations that commit the specified road traffic violations.

id: improper avoidance of an oncoming vehicle
ten: IMPROPER AVOIDANCE OF AN ONCOMING VEHICLE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation involving failure to avoid an oncoming vehicle in accordance with regulations, excluding the separately specified misuse of high-beam headlights.
A violation of regulations governing the securing of transported goods.
Violating regulations governing the securing of transported goods.
The violation of stopping or parking a vehicle in an unauthorized place on an expressway.

id: improper highway use or vehicle maneuver
ten: IMPROPER HIGHWAY USE OR VEHICLE MANEUVER
mo_ta: Entering a highway, stopping or parking, making a U-turn, reversing, overtaking, turning, or changing lanes contrary to regulations and thereby causing a traffic accident while operating a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle. The provision sets a fine of 10,000,000 to 14,000,000 Vietnamese đồng for this violation.

id: improper issuance of a modification certificate
ten: IMPROPER ISSUANCE OF A MODIFICATION CERTIFICATE
mo_ta: A violation in which an inspection facility issues a modification certificate for a motor vehicle or specialized-use vehicle contrary to regulations. The stated fine is 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: improper issuance of vehicle registrations and license plates
ten: IMPROPER ISSUANCE OF VEHICLE REGISTRATIONS AND LICENSE PLATES
mo_ta: The issuance of vehicle registration certificates or license plates in violation of law; the text identifies this as a circumstance for revoking them under Article 39 of Law 36/2024/QH15.

**IMPROPER LANE CHANGE** is a road-traffic violation involving failure to follow lane-change rules. It includes changing lanes where prohibited, failing to signal in advance, moving across more than one lane at a time rather than into an immediately adjacent lane, or changing lanes without maintaining a safe distance from nearby vehicles. On expressways, a driver must not cross more than one adjacent lane in a single lane change. The stated provision excludes violations covered by Article 6, Clause 5, Point g. It also encompasses changing lanes contrary to regulations while operating a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle when that conduct causes a traffic accident.

id: improper lane change on an expressway
ten: IMPROPER LANE CHANGE ON AN EXPRESSWAY
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation described in the decree: changing lanes where it is not permitted, changing lanes without signaling in advance while driving on an expressway, or moving across more than one adjacent lane in a single lane change. The stated fine is 3,000,000 to 5,000,000 Vietnamese dong.

id: improper or altered vehicle license plate violations
ten: IMPROPER OR ALTERED VEHICLE LICENSE PLATE VIOLATIONS
mo_ta: The violations listed in Article 14, Clause 3: placing a vehicle license plate incorrectly or contrary to regulations; using a plate with unclear characters or numbers; covering or altering its characters, numbers, colors, shape, or dimensions; or applying other materials over its characters or numbers.

**IMPROPER OVERTAKING** is a traffic violation involving overtaking contrary to traffic regulations. It includes cases in which a person operating a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle overtakes unlawfully and causes a traffic accident.
Reversing a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle contrary to regulations, when this causes a traffic accident.

id: improper road use by a person controlling or leading an animal
ten: IMPROPER ROAD USE BY A PERSON CONTROLLING OR LEADING AN ANIMAL
mo_ta: A specified road traffic violation: controlling or leading an animal outside the designated portion of the road, onto a prohibited road or restricted area, or into the portion of the road designated for motor vehicles.
Using the roadway for a purpose other than its intended traffic use, identified in the decree’s heading as a category of violation.
A violation of requirements for securing goods during transport, referenced in Article 12.
Using the sidewalk for a purpose other than its intended use, identified in the decree’s heading as a category of violation.
Stopping or parking a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle contrary to regulations, when this causes a traffic accident.

id: improper stopping or parking at a road-rail level crossing
ten: IMPROPER STOPPING OR PARKING AT A ROAD-RAIL LEVEL CROSSING
mo_ta: A traffic violation consisting of failing to follow the rules for stopping or parking where a road crosses a railway at the same level.

id: improper stopping or parking in a road tunnel
ten: IMPROPER STOPPING OR PARKING IN A ROAD TUNNEL
mo_ta: **IMPROPER STOPPING OR PARKING IN A ROAD TUNNEL** is a traffic violation involving stopping or parking a vehicle where it is not permitted or at a place in a road tunnel not designated for that purpose. It includes bicycles, motorized bicycles, and other rudimentary vehicles. Under Clause 4, Article 7 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the stated fine is 800,000 to 1,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: improper stopping or parking on a highway
ten: IMPROPER STOPPING OR PARKING ON A HIGHWAY
mo_ta: A traffic violation involving stopping or parking on a highway in a location not permitted by the rules.
The violation of storing certification files, documents, or data in a manner that does not comply with regulations.
The violation of storing inspection files, documents, or data about vehicle inspections or modifications contrary to regulations, punishable by a fine of 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.

id: improper training completion recognition or certificate issuance
ten: IMPROPER TRAINING COMPLETION RECOGNITION OR CERTIFICATE ISSUANCE
mo_ta: A regulatory violation in which a driver training establishment improperly recognizes a learner's completion of a course or issues a primary-level or training certificate contrary to regulations
A road traffic violation involving failing to signal a turn, or failing to signal continuously while turning.
Turning contrary to regulations while operating a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle, when this causes a traffic accident.
Making a U-turn contrary to regulations while operating a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle, when this causes a traffic accident.

IMPROPER USE OF HIGH BEAMS is a road-traffic violation involving the use of high-beam headlights where they are prohibited: when approaching pedestrians crossing the road, driving through a residential area with functioning street lighting, meeting an oncoming vehicle unless an anti-glare median applies, or turning at an intersection. For covered vehicle operators, the violation is punishable by a fine of 200,000 to 400,000 VND.

id: improper use of high-beam headlights when avoiding an oncoming vehicle
ten: IMPROPER USE OF HIGH-BEAM HEADLIGHTS WHEN AVOIDING AN ONCOMING VEHICLE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation involving use of high-beam headlights when avoiding an oncoming vehicle; the text identifies it as an exception to the violation described under Clause 5 and refers to its regulation in Article 6, Clause 3, Point b.

id: improper use of roadways or sidewalks
ten: IMPROPER USE OF ROADWAYS OR SIDEWALKS
mo_ta: **IMPROPER USE OF ROADWAYS OR SIDEWALKS** is a violation involving use of a roadway or sidewalk for a purpose not permitted by applicable rules. This conduct is covered by Article 12 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.
A violation involving avoiding another vehicle contrary to traffic regulations.

id: improper vehicle maneuver causing a traffic accident
ten: IMPROPER VEHICLE MANEUVER CAUSING A TRAFFIC ACCIDENT
mo_ta: Stopping, parking, turning around, reversing, yielding, overtaking, changing direction, or changing lanes contrary to regulations and causing a traffic accident.

A road-traffic violation involving avoiding another vehicle in a manner that does not comply with regulations; the text states it is punishable by a fine of 200,000 to 400,000 VND for covered vehicle operators.

id: improperly carrying people on a vehicle bed
ten: IMPROPERLY CARRYING PEOPLE ON A VEHICLE BED
mo_ta: A road traffic violation described in the decree: carrying people on a vehicle bed contrary to regulations.
A traffic violation committed when a passenger on a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle wears a helmet without fastening its chin strap correctly while participating in road traffic.
A road-traffic violation in which a driver of a motorcycle, moped, or similar vehicle wears a helmet but does not fasten its chin strap correctly.
A violation in which a driving test center knowingly allows vehicles or scoring equipment to operate inaccurately during a driving test.
An unforeseen occurrence that affects departure timing and causes foreigners or foreign vehicles to leave later than the approved time or exceed the maximum permitted stay in Vietnam.

id: incident involving a foreign motor vehicle
ten: INCIDENT INVOLVING A FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLE
mo_ta: An incident caused by or related to a foreign motor vehicle while it is participating in traffic in Vietnam
A duty to remedy incidents, including incidents arising from natural disasters or epidemics; vehicles assigned to this work may be priority vehicles.

id: incidents caused by foreign motor vehicles
ten: INCIDENTS CAUSED BY FOREIGN MOTOR VEHICLES
mo_ta: Incidents involving or caused by foreign motor vehicles; unresolved incidents may be grounds for refusing approval.

Incidents caused by or otherwise related to foreign motor vehicles during their participation in traffic in Vietnam; the relevant People's Committee must notify the designated ministries and representative bodies.
Inciting others in connection with a road traffic accident.

id: incitement in connection with a road traffic accident
ten: INCITEMENT IN CONNECTION WITH A ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENT
mo_ta: Using an accident as an opportunity to incite others, prohibited by Article 9 of Law 36/2024/QH15.

INCITING ILLEGAL RACING is the act of encouraging or instigating illegal vehicle racing. Article 35 identifies this conduct as subject to penalties and deductions from the driver’s-license point total.
Inciting illegal road racing is prohibited under Article 9 of Law 36/2024/QH15.

id: inciting, assisting, or encouraging illegal road racing
ten: INCITING, ASSISTING, OR ENCOURAGING ILLEGAL ROAD RACING
mo_ta: Inciting, assisting, or encouraging illegal road racing is listed as prohibited conduct under Article 9 of Law 36/2024/QH15.
Individuals who own motorcycles, mopeds, or similar vehicles and may be fined 200,000 to 300,000 Vietnamese đồng for the stated emissions-certificate violation.
A fine of 10,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese dong applicable to an individual vehicle owner for the specified conduct.
Individuals who arrange for right-hand-drive cars to enter and participate in traffic in Vietnam for purposes other than tourism.

id: individual transport business operator and direct driver
ten: INDIVIDUAL TRANSPORT BUSINESS OPERATOR AND DIRECT DRIVER
mo_ta: The individual described in the text who operates a transport business and directly drives the vehicle involved in the violation.
An individual leasing a vehicle under a financial lease. Under the decree, the lessee is treated as the vehicle owner for purposes of imposing penalties.

id: individual vehicle license plate auction winner
ten: INDIVIDUAL VEHICLE LICENSE PLATE AUCTION WINNER
mo_ta: A person who wins a vehicle license plate auction and may register the auctioned plate on a vehicle they own at the police agency managing the plate or where they have permanent or temporary residence

An **INDIVIDUAL VEHICLE OWNER** is a person who owns a vehicle covered by the relevant provisions, including a car, motorized four-wheel passenger or cargo vehicle, specialized motorcycle, or similar vehicle. When a violation is detected, the owner may be required to cooperate with the authorities to identify the driver.

Depending on the specific violation and applicable provision, an individual vehicle owner may be subject to penalties, including a fine of **4,000,000–6,000,000 VND** or, for another specified violation, **28,000,000–30,000,000 VND**. In cases involving a towed trailer or semi-trailer, the owner of the car may be treated as the vehicle owner for the purposes of the violation.

**Individual vehicle owners** are individuals who own cars, four-wheeled motor vehicles, specialized or special-use motorcycles, motorcycles, mopeds, or similar vehicles. Depending on the vehicle and the specific violation, they may be fined for specified road-traffic, registration, or permitted-use violations. The cited provisions prescribe fines of **300,000–400,000 VND** or **28–30 million VND** for certain violations involving cars and other covered motor vehicles; **800,000–1,000,000 VND** for a specified violation involving motorcycles or mopeds; and **4–6 million VND** for specified violations involving covered vehicles, including unauthorized vehicle alterations under Article 32, Clause 8.

An **INDIVIDUAL VIOLATOR** is a person who commits a violation covered by the cited provisions, including Article 32 or other listed road-traffic-order and safety violations. Depending on the applicable provision, the individual may face a monetary penalty and deduction of points from their driver’s license. The term may also refer to a violator who has not yet completed the competent state agency’s requirements for resolving the administrative violation.

**INDIVIDUAL VIOLATORS** are individuals who commit violations covered by Article 40 or other specified road-traffic regulations. These violations may involve roadways or sidewalks, environmental protection, passenger capacity, vehicle or road limits, cargo securing, and driver training or driving tests. Depending on the violation, individuals may face specified fines and additional penalties, including the withdrawal of vehicle documents that are altered, forged, or improperly issued.

**Individuals** are persons affected by Vietnam’s road-traffic order and safety rules in several roles. They may be sources of amendments or supplements used to update the Road Traffic Order and Safety Database, and may be involved in checks of legal knowledge concerning road traffic order and safety. Their lawful rights and interests must be respected and protected during patrols, controls, accident investigations, and resolutions; those processes must not be misused or abused to infringe those rights.

Individuals may apply to bring right-hand-drive cars into traffic in Vietnam for purposes other than tourism, subject to approval and possible refusal following a violation. Individuals who own intelligent transport vehicles must prepare the required application dossier and submit it to the competent licensing authority.

Individuals who commit specified road-transport or traffic-order violations may face administrative fines and other consequences. The cited provisions include fines of **VND 1,000,000–2,000,000**; **VND 2,000,000–3,000,000** for certain unauthorized uses of roadways or sidewalks; **VND 3,000,000–4,000,000** for specified violations in road transport or support services; **VND 4,000,000–6,000,000** for a specified violation; and **VND 5,000,000–6,000,000** for various listed violations, including certain passenger-transfer, journey-monitoring-device, and road-transport offenses. The applicable fine depends on the particular violation. Individuals who overload vehicles may be fined under Article 26, while those using drivers or cargo escorts without required dangerous-goods transport training may also be penalized.

Higher fines include **VND 10,000,000–12,000,000** for specified road-transport business violations resulting in a serious-or-greater traffic accident and for prohibited purchases or sales of vehicle registration plates. Organizing illegal racing, and repeating certain specified violations, may result in fines of **VND 40,000,000–50,000,000**.

Depending on the offense, individuals may also face additional penalties, including revocation of specified vehicle documents under Article 32, corrective measures under Article 26, or surrender of unlawful gains under Article 31. Individuals may provide technical equipment or collected results used to identify administrative violators, but may themselves be sanctioned if they intentionally evade or obstruct enforcement.

Individuals Bringing Right-Hand-Drive Cars are people who bring right-hand-drive cars into traffic in Vietnam for road use, including for purposes other than tourism. Their use of these vehicles is subject to the applicable requirements and approval provisions set out in the decree, including Article 33 and Appendix IV. Where specified, they may also be required to submit a notice if their travel or departure arrangements change.

id: individuals bringing right-hand-drive cars into traffic
ten: INDIVIDUALS BRINGING RIGHT-HAND-DRIVE CARS INTO TRAFFIC
mo_ta: Individuals bringing right-hand-drive cars into traffic in Vietnam are those who use or introduce such vehicles on Vietnamese roads for purposes other than tourism.

id: individuals bringing right-hand-drive cars into vietnam
ten: INDIVIDUALS BRINGING RIGHT-HAND-DRIVE CARS INTO VIETNAM
mo_ta: Individuals bringing right-hand-drive cars into Vietnam are people who bring those vehicles into Vietnamese traffic for purposes other than tourism. They are identified in the heading of Article 35.

Individuals who commit administrative violations are responsible for carrying out the required remedial measure of returning licenses or certificates that have been erased or altered so their contents are inaccurate.
People who discover a qualifying unexpected situation or road traffic accident and are required to take the reporting or safety-warning actions described in Article 76.

id: individuals involved in road traffic accidents
ten: INDIVIDUALS INVOLVED IN ROAD TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS
mo_ta: Individuals involved in a road traffic accident are responsible for cooperating in its resolution, as stated in Article 83 of Law 36/2024/QH15.
Individuals who may arrange for right-hand-drive cars to participate in road traffic in Vietnam for non-tourism purposes, subject to the applicable approval process.

id: individuals organizing vehicle entry or use
ten: INDIVIDUALS ORGANIZING VEHICLE ENTRY OR USE
mo_ta: Individuals who may organize the entry into Vietnam of foreign-registered, right-hand-drive cars for purposes other than tourism, subject to prior approval by a competent authority.
Individuals who repeat the violations specified in points a and h of clause 7 of Article 26. They are subject to fines of 40 million to 50 million Vietnamese dong.
Individuals who commit the specified violation are subject to a fine of 10,000,000 to 12,000,000 Vietnamese dong.
A violation consisting of operating a qualifying passenger-transport vehicle with driver-image recording equipment that does not function while the vehicle is participating in traffic.
Public information and communications agencies responsible for organizing the dissemination of laws on road traffic order and safety through mass media
Collection of information and data as part of investigating and resolving a road traffic accident
An event in which information changes or database records are found to be incomplete or inaccurate, prompting information updates.

id: information collection for the road traffic order and safety database
ten: INFORMATION COLLECTION FOR THE ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY DATABASE
mo_ta: INFORMATION COLLECTION FOR THE ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY DATABASE is the Article 12 process of gathering information from the databases and data categories specified in the referenced provisions, including the National Database on Finance.

id: information collection in the road traffic order and road safety database
ten: INFORMATION COLLECTION IN THE ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND ROAD SAFETY DATABASE
mo_ta: The information-gathering activity described in Article 12 of Decree 151/2024/ND-CP. The text states that information specified in Clause 6, Article 11 of the decree is collected from sources, but does not identify those sources.
The process described in Article 12, clause 9, of Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP, in which information specified in Article 11, clause 13, is collected from databases referenced in clause 1.
The collection of information specified in Article 11, Clause 9, for the road traffic order and safety database, sourced from the database on administrative-violation handling.

id: information updating in the road traffic order and safety database
ten: INFORMATION UPDATING IN THE ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY DATABASE
mo_ta: The activity described in Article 13 of Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP: updating the road traffic order and safety database by adding and adjusting information from specified sources.

id: infringement of life, health, or property
ten: INFRINGEMENT OF LIFE, HEALTH, OR PROPERTY
mo_ta: A prohibited act described in the text as infringing on the life, health, or property of people involved in a road traffic accident or helping those affected.

id: inheritance of a vehicle with an auction-winning plate
ten: INHERITANCE OF A VEHICLE WITH AN AUCTION-WINNING PLATE
mo_ta: The inheritance of a vehicle associated with a license plate won at auction; in this case, only the vehicle registration certificate is revoked.
The initial emergency treatment provided by a healthcare facility to a person injured in a road traffic accident.

id: initial issuance of priority-vehicle signal-device permits
ten: INITIAL ISSUANCE OF PRIORITY-VEHICLE SIGNAL-DEVICE PERMITS
mo_ta: The procedure for initially issuing permits to use signal devices on priority vehicles, referenced in the title of Article 21 alongside the reissuance procedure.<
The procedure for issuing a new permit to use a signal device on a priority vehicle, covered alongside permit reissuance in Article 21
INJURED PEOPLE are individuals hurt in a road traffic accident. They may be transported for emergency care, and their statements may be recorded as part of the accident investigation.

An **INJURED PERSON** is someone harmed in a road traffic accident whose life, health, or property may be affected. The driver or vehicle operator, along with other responsible people at the scene, should assist the injured person and help protect their property. If necessary, the injured person should be taken for emergency medical care.
An administrative activity listed as part of state management of road traffic order and safety.

id: inspection and administrative sanctioning of road traffic violations
ten: INSPECTION AND ADMINISTRATIVE SANCTIONING OF ROAD TRAFFIC VIOLATIONS
mo_ta: The activity addressed in Article 41 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP: inspections concerning road transport and related facilities, during which designated officials may sanction specified administrative violations affecting road traffic order and safety.

INSPECTION AND CONTROL refers to checks and control activities carried out by persons performing official duties on road traffic participants and vehicles. These activities are conducted after a vehicle has been stopped, and include the examinations performed, their content and results. Road traffic participants are required to comply with these activities.

id: inspection and control of road users
ten: INSPECTION AND CONTROL OF ROAD USERS
mo_ta: Inspection and control of people participating in road traffic, included as a component of road traffic patrol and control activities under Article 65, Clause 1 of Law 36/2024/QH15.

id: inspection and control of road vehicles
ten: INSPECTION AND CONTROL OF ROAD VEHICLES
mo_ta: Inspection and control of vehicles participating in road traffic, included as a component of road traffic patrol and control activities under Article 65, Clause 1 of Law 36/2024/QH15.
Requests made by persons performing official duties, which road traffic participants are required to obey.

id: inspection and testing of vehicles and parts
ten: INSPECTION AND TESTING OF VEHICLES AND PARTS
mo_ta: Inspection and testing of motor vehicles, specialized motor vehicles, and motor vehicle parts to assess technical safety quality and environmental protection.

Issuing an inspection certificate for a motor vehicle or specialized-use motorcycle contrary to applicable regulations, standards, or technical requirements is a punishable violation under Article 40, Clause 4.

id: inspection delegation established by the director general of the vietnam road administration
ten: INSPECTION DELEGATION ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR GENERAL OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: An inspection delegation established by the Director General of the Vietnam Road Administration; its leader is included among officials with penalty-imposing authority under Article 44.

id: inspection delegation established by the director of the vietnam road administration
ten: INSPECTION DELEGATION ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: The Inspection Delegation Established by the Director of the Vietnam Road Administration is an inspection body created by the Director. Under Article 44, its head is authorized to impose administrative penalties, including issuing warnings, imposing fines of up to 60,000,000 đồng, suspending or revoking permits, and applying remedial measures.

id: inspection delegation established by the minister of construction
ten: INSPECTION DELEGATION ESTABLISHED BY THE MINISTER OF CONSTRUCTION
mo_ta: The **Inspection Delegation Established by the Minister of Construction** is an inspection body whose head is among the officials authorized under Article 44 to impose administrative penalties. The head may issue warnings, impose fines of up to 75,000,000 đồng, suspend or revoke permits, and apply remedial measures.

An **INSPECTION FACILITY** is a public-service organization that inspects motor vehicles and specialized motor vehicles for technical safety and environmental protection, and certifies modified vehicles. Its inspectors conduct these inspections, and the facility issues inspection certificates. The facility is responsible for its inspection and certification results and may refuse to conduct an inspection only in circumstances specified by law. It is an entity subject to the responsibilities set out in Article 43; under Article 40, a facility that commits a listed violation may be fined between 10,000,000 and 15,000,000 Vietnamese đồng.
Inspectors who carry out technical safety and environmental protection inspections of motor vehicles and specialized motorcycles

An inspection facility’s refusal to inspect a vehicle, permitted only in specified circumstances, including a legal-proceeding authority’s request, an unresolved administrative-violation requirement, registration-information discrepancies, failure to replace a registration certificate after modification certification, or suspected falsification of vehicle documents.
The process by which a person registers for an inspection and selects an inspection date using Form No. 01 in the accompanying appendix.

id: inspection team established by the director general of the vietnam road administration
ten: INSPECTION TEAM ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR GENERAL OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: An inspection team established by the Director General of the Vietnam Road Administration is listed as having authority to impose penalties under Article 41.

id: inspection team established by the director of the vietnam road administration
ten: INSPECTION TEAM ESTABLISHED BY THE DIRECTOR OF THE VIETNAM ROAD ADMINISTRATION
mo_ta: The inspection team established by the Director of the Vietnam Road Administration is listed in Article 44 among the bodies whose officials have administrative sanctioning authority. Under Article 44(2), the team’s head or leader is authorized to impose fines of up to 60,000,000 đồng, apply remedial measures, and temporarily revoke permits or suspend activities.

id: inspection team established by the minister of construction
ten: INSPECTION TEAM ESTABLISHED BY THE MINISTER OF CONSTRUCTION
mo_ta: The **Inspection Team Established by the Minister of Construction** is a ministerial inspection team whose head is among the officials authorized to impose administrative penalties. Article 44, clause 3, specifies that the team’s head may impose fines of up to 75 million Vietnamese dong. The team is also referenced in connection with penalty authority under Article 41.
Violations of rules governing motor vehicle and specialized motorcycle inspection activities and related components; specified violations may incur additional penalties.
Inspectors are officials who, while performing official duties, have authority to apply the remedial measures specified in the decree.

id: installation and use of audio and lighting equipment
ten: INSTALLATION AND USE OF AUDIO AND LIGHTING EQUIPMENT
mo_ta: The act of installing or using audio and lighting equipment on motor vehicles or specialized motorcycles in a way that disrupts public order or road traffic safety; the text identifies this conduct as prohibited.

id: installation and use of priority-vehicle signal equipment
ten: INSTALLATION AND USE OF PRIORITY-VEHICLE SIGNAL EQUIPMENT
mo_ta: The activity of installing and using signal equipment reserved for priority vehicles, addressed in Article 18 of Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP.

Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP requires the installation of driver-image recording devices in vehicles used for commercial passenger transport that have at least eight passenger seats, as well as in tractor-trucks, ambulances, and road-rescue vehicles.

The **INSTALLATION OF JOURNEY-MONITORING DEVICES** requirement under Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP applies to specified commercial-transport and internal-transport vehicles. It includes cars used for commercial transport.

id: installation of priority vehicle signal equipment
ten: INSTALLATION OF PRIORITY VEHICLE SIGNAL EQUIPMENT
mo_ta: An installation activity specified in Clause 2 of Article 17 of Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP. For motorcycles, priority lights are installed on both sides of the crash bar or vehicle body and above the rear pillar; the priority horn is installed at the front of the vehicle, and the priority flag is installed at the front on the driver's left side.
The activity of installing signal-emitting equipment on priority vehicles.
A required remedial measure for the specified road traffic violation: installing specialized rescue and rescue-support tools or equipment on the vehicle in accordance with regulations.

id: installation or replacement of compliant equipment
ten: INSTALLATION OR REPLACEMENT OF COMPLIANT EQUIPMENT
mo_ta: A corrective measure requiring the operator to install missing equipment or replace equipment so that it meets technical safety standards and regulations.

id: installing non-safety glass in a vehicle
ten: INSTALLING NON-SAFETY GLASS IN A VEHICLE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation consisting of fitting a vehicle with a windshield or door windows that are not safety glass. The text identifies this conduct as subject to the fines in Article 32, Clause 2 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.

id: installing or using sound or lighting equipment on a vehicle
ten: INSTALLING OR USING SOUND OR LIGHTING EQUIPMENT ON A VEHICLE
mo_ta: A road-traffic violation involving the installation or use of sound or lighting equipment on a vehicle in a way that disrupts road traffic order and safety. Under Clause 7 of Article 32 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP, the stated fine is 4,000,000–6,000,000 VND for an individual vehicle owner and 8,000,000–12,000,000 VND for an organizational vehicle owner.

id: instructing passengers on the use of vehicle safety equipment
ten: INSTRUCTING PASSENGERS ON THE USE OF VEHICLE SAFETY EQUIPMENT
mo_ta: A required practice in passenger transport by automobile: guiding passengers in how to use the vehicle’s safety equipment.
Prohibited conduct under Article 9 of Law 36/2024/QH15, involving insulting passengers.

An insurance company covering people, vehicles, or property involved in a road traffic accident; upon receiving an accident report, it must send a person or authorize a representative to go to the scene and coordinate with the unit handling the accident
A person directly sent by an insurance enterprise, or authorized to represent it, to attend the scene of a road traffic accident and coordinate with the unit handling the accident
Insurance enterprises are responsible for coordinating with the police agency to arrange rescue vehicles for vehicles involved in a road traffic accident when necessary.
A person holding a driving licence that combines categories with different validity periods; while one category is suspended, the person may have the unaffected category issued or renewed.
The use and operation of intelligent devices that support the direction and control of road traffic.

id: intelligent traffic vehicle operating license application
ten: INTELLIGENT TRAFFIC VEHICLE OPERATING LICENSE APPLICATION
mo_ta: The licensing procedure described in Article 25 for obtaining authorization to operate intelligent traffic vehicles. The application dossier must include a request for an operating license using the prescribed form.
The administrative process for obtaining an operating permit for an intelligent traffic vehicle. The licensing authority issues the permit within five working days after receiving the application.

id: intelligent traffic vehicle permit replacement or reissuance
ten: INTELLIGENT TRAFFIC VEHICLE PERMIT REPLACEMENT OR REISSUANCE
mo_ta: The administrative process for replacing a damaged intelligent traffic vehicle operating permit or reissuing a lost one. The licensing authority processes the request within two working days after receiving the application.

The process of revoking an intelligent traffic vehicle operating permit when it falls within the circumstances specified in Article 25, clause 5. The owner or authorized representative must surrender the permit to the competent authority that issued it.
A center for managing the intelligent transport system, identified as a system or database with which the traffic command center may connect and share data.
The procedure for obtaining a permit to operate an intelligent transport vehicle, referenced in the heading of Article 25a of Decree No. 151/2024/ND-CP.

id: intelligent transport vehicle operating license revocation
ten: INTELLIGENT TRANSPORT VEHICLE OPERATING LICENSE REVOCATION
mo_ta: The process described in Article 25 of Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP, in which a license subject to revocation must be surrendered to the competent authority that issued it.

id: intelligent transport vehicle operating permit application
ten: INTELLIGENT TRANSPORT VEHICLE OPERATING PERMIT APPLICATION
mo_ta: The process of applying for authorization to operate an intelligent transport vehicle. The application requires vehicle quality or inspection-exemption information, registration data, and vehicle-owner documents.

id: intelligent transport vehicle operating permit licensing
ten: INTELLIGENT TRANSPORT VEHICLE OPERATING PERMIT LICENSING
mo_ta: The administrative process for granting permits to operate intelligent transport vehicles, addressed in Article 25a.

id: intelligent transport vehicle operating-permit application procedure
ten: INTELLIGENT TRANSPORT VEHICLE OPERATING-PERMIT APPLICATION PROCEDURE
mo_ta: The application procedure requires the vehicle owner to prepare one dossier and submit it to the competent licensing authority online, through postal service, or in person.

The regulatory process described in Article 25 for authorizing the operation of intelligent transport vehicles, with ordinary permits issued by local traffic police and permits for national-defense vehicles issued by the Department of Military Vehicles and Transport.

id: intentional alteration of a traffic accident scene
ten: INTENTIONAL ALTERATION OF A TRAFFIC ACCIDENT SCENE
mo_ta: The conduct of intentionally changing or erasing traces at the scene of a road traffic accident, which the decree identifies as a punishable violation.
The intentional alteration of the distance reading shown on a car's odometer, identified in the text as a violation subject to a fine for the vehicle owner.

A violation involving the use of technical measures, external equipment, or other means to interfere with monitoring equipment and falsify recorded theoretical study time or practical driving instruction time and distance.

id: interference with the handling of road traffic violations
ten: INTERFERENCE WITH THE HANDLING OF ROAD TRAFFIC VIOLATIONS
mo_ta: A prohibited act under Article 9 of Vietnam’s Law 36/2024/QH15: interfering with or influencing the process of handling violations of laws on road traffic order and safety.

id: intergovernmental international organization representative offices in vietnam
ten: INTERGOVERNMENTAL INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATION REPRESENTATIVE OFFICES IN VIETNAM
mo_ta: Representative offices in Vietnam of intergovernmental international organizations. Their diplomatic notes may support applications for vehicles to participate in traffic in Vietnam.

Intergovernmental international organizations are organizations formed by governments. Under the relevant decree, their representative offices in Vietnam may issue an official dispatch or diplomatic note requesting authorization for foreign vehicles to participate in Vietnamese traffic for non-tourism purposes.
The inspection of compliance with internal military regulations on roads.
Organizations that operate internal transportation and are responsible for implementing the requirements in Article 64 of Law 36/2024/QH15.

id: international agreements on mutual recognition of international driving permits
ten: INTERNATIONAL AGREEMENTS ON MUTUAL RECOGNITION OF INTERNATIONAL DRIVING PERMITS
mo_ta: International agreements signed by Vietnam that provide for mutual recognition of international driving permits.

International border gates are designated international crossing points. Foreign vehicles may be temporarily imported and re-exported through them when the competent authorities have approved the crossing. For travelers holding electronic visas, entry into Vietnam must take place through the international border gates designated by the Government of Vietnam.

The **INTERNATIONAL BORDER-GATE ECONOMIC ZONE** is a designated economic area at an international border gate referenced in Article 38 of Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP. Vehicles may be registered to operate in such a zone. In connection with traffic violations and penalties, the decree may also require a vehicle involved in specified violations to return to the zone as an administrative remedial measure. No particular zone is identified.

International border-gate economic zones are areas identified in Article 38 where vehicles may be registered to operate. Vehicle operation in these zones falls within the scope of the penalties established by the cited law. If a vehicle’s registration period expires, the law provides grounds for revoking its vehicle registration certificate and license plate.

id: international cooperation on road traffic order and safety
ten: INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION ON ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY
mo_ta:
**International Cooperation on Road Traffic Order and Safety** is an area of state management under Article 86 of Law No. 36/2024/QH15 and is described in Article 8, Clause 2. It covers international cooperation on road traffic order and safety, including cooperation to strengthen the material conditions needed to maintain that order and safety.

The Ministry of Public Security leads and carries out this cooperation in coordination with relevant ministries and sectors. It must be conducted in accordance with Vietnamese law and relevant international treaties, while respecting international law and protecting Vietnam’s independence, sovereignty, unity, territorial integrity, and lawful interests.
The issuance and use of international driver permits, addressed by regulations referenced in the text.

id: international driver’s license issuance and use
ten: INTERNATIONAL DRIVER’S LICENSE ISSUANCE AND USE

**Investigation and Resolution of Road Traffic Accidents** is part of the state management of road traffic order and safety and is addressed in Article 83 of Vietnam’s Law No. 36/2024/QH15. The process must be carried out promptly, accurately, objectively, and in accordance with the law, without being misused or abused to infringe the State’s interests or the lawful rights and interests of organizations or individuals.

The applicable procedure depends on whether the accident shows signs of a criminal offense. If it does, the case is handled under criminal law and criminal procedure law. LAW 118/2025/QH15 is a Vietnamese law whose Article 7 amends and supplements provisions of the Law on Road Traffic Order and Safety. Under Article 11, the law generally takes effect on July 1, 2026, subject to the exception in Clause 2: point a, Clause 20, Article 7 takes effect earlier, on January 1, 2026.

**Law No. 36/2024/QH15**, passed by Vietnam’s National Assembly on June 27, 2024, is the Law on Road Traffic Order and Safety. It establishes a broad legal framework for safe and orderly road traffic, including the responsibilities of road users, vehicle operators, public authorities, and transport businesses.

The law sets out state policies, governing principles, public education and international cooperation, and a database for road-traffic order and safety (Articles 3–8). Article 9 identifies prohibited conduct, including unsafe or unlawful vehicle operation and transport, unauthorized vehicle alterations, and misuse of traffic or monitoring data. Articles 10–33 regulate road-user conduct: obeying signals and speed and distance rules; lane use, overtaking, turning, stopping, parking, reversing, and opening vehicle doors; and travel on expressways, in tunnels, or across ferries. They also address priority vehicles, pedestrians and people needing assistance, animal-drawn and rudimentary vehicles, and motorcycle and moped drivers, passengers, and cargo.

Articles 34–43 cover vehicle classifications and roadworthiness, vehicle registration and identification plates, service-life limits, technical-safety and environmental requirements, inspections, and the responsibilities of vehicle owners, operators, and inspection establishments. Articles 44–55 regulate transport activities and specialized circumstances, including urban transport, passenger and school transport, goods and dangerous goods, live animals and fresh food, oversized or overweight loads and tracked vehicles, and foreign-registered vehicles operating in Vietnam.

The law also governs operator eligibility and licensing. Articles 56–63 address age and health conditions, driving-licence categories and validity, licence points, training and tests, licence issuance and exchange, and qualifications for specialized-motorcycle operators. Article 64 limits working and continuous driving time for drivers in commercial and internal transport. Articles 65–73 provide for patrol, control, vehicle stops, violation detection, monitoring systems, data management, and measures against obstruction or resistance to officials. Articles 74–79 cover traffic command and control, unexpected disruptions, and temporary use of roadways or sidewalks.

Articles 82–87 address accident rescue and recovery, investigation and resolution, statistics, the Road Traffic Accident Damage Mitigation Fund, and state-management responsibilities. Article 88 concerns implementation and effectiveness; Article 89 sets transitional rules, including continued validity or conversion of certain pre-existing licences, registration documents, and other arrangements.

**LAW NO. 36/2024/QH15** is a Vietnamese law governing road traffic order and safety. It covers traffic rules; vehicles and road users; traffic direction, control, patrol, and inspection; responses to road traffic accidents; and the responsibilities of state authorities. Its provisions include:

- **State policy, education, and cooperation:** Articles 4–8 address state policy and resources, public education and dissemination of traffic laws, family members’ responsibility to encourage compliance and protect young children on motorcycles, road-safety databases, and international cooperation.
- **Road-user conduct and vehicle use:** Articles 9–30 cover prohibited acts, child restraints and seating in cars, expressway use, horn signals, overtaking and yielding, towing, pedestrians and other specified road users, and when people may ride in the cargo bed of a goods vehicle. They also address passengers and goods carried on motorcycles, mopeds, and rudimentary vehicles.
- **Vehicles and transport operations:** Articles 34–57 classify vehicles and set participation and registration requirements; regulate license plates, auctions, inspection, and vehicle safety and environmental standards; and establish rules for passenger and goods transport. These include duties of passenger-vehicle drivers and service staff, safety requirements for school and preschool transport, and conditions for oversized, overweight, tracked, foreign-registered, and right-hand-drive vehicles. The law also addresses driving eligibility for people with disabilities.
- **Licensing and enforcement:** Articles 60–73 cover driver training and licence eligibility, exchange, reissuance, and revocation; patrol and control powers and procedures; equipment used during patrols; monitoring systems and data management, including personal-data protection; and measures against refusing or obstructing official inspections. Article 65 includes duties of traffic police, while Article 72 addresses road users’ rights and responsibilities.
- **Road infrastructure and public administration:** Articles 77–87 cover temporary use of roads and sidewalks, congestion remedies, safety recommendations for road works and infrastructure hazards, the Road Traffic Accident Damage Mitigation Fund, and the content and allocation of state-management responsibilities, including those of the Ministry of Health.

Article 89 provides transitional rules for certain licences issued before the law takes effect, including conversion or reissuance according to prior licence classes and certificates for operating specialized tractors. Article 88 establishes commencement and generally renders Road Traffic Law No. 23/2008/QH12 ineffective, subject to Article 89’s exceptions; it also provides that Clause 3 of Article 10 takes effect on July 1, 2026.

The **Law on Handling Administrative Violations** is Vietnamese legislation governing the handling and sanctioning of administrative violations. It sets out rules for determining whether a violation is continuing or has ended, which affects calculation of the limitation period for imposing penalties; Clause 1 of Article 6 is cited as the source of the applicable limitation period.

The law also provides procedures and authority for enforcement. Article 125—including point b of Clause 1 and Clauses 2 and 8—is cited as the legal basis for temporarily seizing or holding vehicles and related documents, including before an administrative penalty decision. Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP refers to the law as the basis for such temporary seizure. Article 66, Clause 1, is cited as authority to extend the time for verifying the person subject to a penalty, while Article 85 governs the return of altered licenses and certificates.

The **LAW ON ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY** is a Vietnamese law governing road traffic order and safety. It provides the legal basis for connecting and sharing information between the road traffic order and safety database and other databases, and for using database information to identify violations. Its provisions are implemented and detailed by Decree 151/2024/NĐ-CP; it is also referenced by Decree 168/2024/NĐ-CP.

The law sets or supplies the basis for rules on vehicle operation and driver requirements. Article 34 addresses categories of rudimentary vehicles whose operating conditions are covered by the decree, while Clause 4 defines the motor vehicles relevant to intelligent transport vehicle provisions. Article 56, including Clauses 1 and 2, is cited for requirements applying to people driving cars, certain four-wheeled motor vehicles, and specialized motorcycles; Clause 1 sets conditions a person must meet to drive in traffic. Other provisions are cited for vehicle eligibility for road rescue, the types of vehicles that may be fitted with priority signal devices and the related licensing and use restrictions, and requirements for vehicles transporting preschool children and pupils, including Point a, Clause 1, Article 46.

Clause 1 of Article 64 establishes rules on permitted driving times and is cited in connection with violations of driving-time limits. The law also provides the basis for conditions governing the operation of non-motorized vehicles. Certain provisions of the **LAW ON ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY** are amended or supplemented by Article 7 of Law No. 118/2025/QH15.

ten: LEAVING THE DRIVER'S POSITION AND TURNING OFF THE ENGINE WHILE STOPPED
mo_ta: A traffic violation involving leaving the driver's position and turning off the engine while stopped, except when leaving to open or close a vehicle door, load or unload goods, or inspect the vehicle.

id: left side of a one-way road
ten: LEFT SIDE OF A ONE-WAY ROAD
mo_ta: The location identified in the passage as a place where vehicles may not be stopped or parked.
A vehicle maneuver in which the vehicle turns to the left, identified as one form of vehicle turning.
The specific overtaking maneuver described for a road with only one motor-vehicle lane in each direction: a vehicle behind moves to the left to pass the vehicle ahead.
Teaching activities concerning knowledge of the law, which Article 8 assigns the ministry responsibility for organizing at vocational education institutions

id: legal education on road traffic order and safety
ten: LEGAL EDUCATION ON ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY
mo_ta: Education in legal knowledge concerning road traffic order and safety, as addressed in Article 6 of Law No. 36/2024/QH15

id: legal knowledge check on road traffic order and safety
ten: LEGAL KNOWLEDGE CHECK ON ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY
mo_ta: A check of legal knowledge concerning road traffic order and safety, whose organization is subject to the conditions specified in Article 5 of Circular 65/2024/TT-BCA.

id: legal knowledge examination on road traffic order and safety
ten: LEGAL KNOWLEDGE EXAMINATION ON ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY
mo_ta: The **LEGAL KNOWLEDGE EXAMINATION ON ROAD TRAFFIC ORDER AND SAFETY** assesses knowledge of laws and regulations concerning road traffic order and safety. It is organized on a monthly schedule, and prospective participants may submit registration applications and select an available examination date.
A repeat of the legal knowledge test that a participant who failed the previous test may register for after seven working days.

The **LEGAL KNOWLEDGE TEST** is an examination of candidates’ knowledge of laws concerning road traffic order and safety. It is generally conducted as a multiple-choice test on a computer using examination software, subject to the exception specified in Clause 8 of Article 7, as amended by Article 2 of the circular. The applicable circular and Article 6 address the test’s content, method, duration and timing, questions, and results.
